title: Estágio em  E-commerce And Business Development
description:
Sobre o Desafio

Você não será apenas um estagiário, mas o braço direito na construção de um novo braço de negócio. Buscamos alguém com perfil empreendedor, que queira entender como se cria uma operação de sucesso. Esta é uma trilha de crescimento acelerado com possibilidade de equity conforme crescimento do negócio.


O que você vai fazer:

  • Análise de Tendências: Monitorar o comportamento do consumidor e identificar produtos vencedores.
  • Gestão de Marketplace: Montar e otimizar a vitrine da loja dentro da Amazon (SEO, imagens, descrições).
  • Inteligência de Dados: Gerar reports semanais de performance, vendas e margem.
  • Operação Comercial: Auxiliar na estratégia para maximizar as vendas e o ROI do negócio.


O que buscamos (Requisitos):

  • Perfil Empreendedor: Alguém que pense como dono e seja orientado a resultados.
  • Analítico: Facilidade com números e interpretação de dados de mercado.
  • Proatividade: Capacidade de buscar soluções para problemas que ainda não têm processo definido.
  • Formação: Cursando Administração, Economia, Engenharia ou áreas correlatas.


O que oferecemos:

  • Bolsa-auxílio: R$ 1.500,00.
  • Plano de Carreira Diferenciado: Possibilidade real de tornar-se sócio do negócio e ter participação nos lucros (Profit Sharing).


Envie seu currículo para com o título:

  • (Seu Nome) | Vaga de Estágio – E-commerce & Business Development

title: Coordenador(a) de Performance & Business Analytics Burger King
description:
Responsabilidades e atribuições:

Como será o seu desafio?


  • Traduzir grande volume de dados operacionais em insights claros e direcionamentos estratégicos para o negócio.
  • Atuar em um ambiente de alta complexidade operacional e grande escala, com centenas de restaurantes e múltiplas alavancas de performance.
  • Influenciar e mobilizar diferentes áreas da empresa para garantir execução efetiva das iniciativas de melhoria.
  • Identificar oportunidades estruturais de crescimento de vendas, melhoria de experiência do cliente e eficiência operacional.
  • Fortalecer uma cultura de gestão orientada por dados, performance e accountability na operação.


Requisitos e qualificações:

Ingredientes Para o Combo:


  • Ensino superior completo em Administração, Marketing ou áreas correlatas;
  • Experiência sólida em modelagem financeira e análise de performance;
  • Conhecimento em modelagem de dados / estatística aplicada, SQL e uso de soluções de IA para automação de análises e processos.


Informações adicionais:

  • Modelo de trabalho: Hibrido
  • Local de trabalho: Bairro Butantã, próximo ao metrô


Informações adicionais:

Benefícios:


• Flex Office;

• Vale Refeição ou Alimentação;

• Cartão Multibenefícios;

• Vale-transporte, estacionamento ou fretado;

• Plano de saúde e odontológico sem coparticipação (inclusive para dependentes);

• Seguro de Vida (desde o 1º dia de admissão);

• Bônus Atrativo Anual;

• Parceria com universidades e instituições de ensino;

• Programas de saúde e bem-estar (telemedicina e psicoterapia online);

• TotalPass (plataforma que oferece acesso a mais de 20 mil academias e parceiros de psicologia, nutrição e bem-estar em um só benefício);

• Day off de aniversário.

title: Brand Manager / Brand Development Leader - Casino slots LATAM market
description:
Please note that we are only considering candidates with proven experience in the LATAM market and experience working with Casino Slots products. Please send you CV in English.


Art of Spin is an ambitious iGaming startup within the Altenar ecosystem. We are building the brand from scratch and planning an aggressive international expansion with a portfolio of innovative slot games and unique mechanics.

Our goal is to become a recognized industry player by leveraging creativity and virality — succeeding where competitors rely primarily on massive marketing budgets.


Your Mission

To take the Art of Spin brand from “unknown” to a top-of-mind choice for operators and players, starting with the LATAM market and expanding into Asia and the United States.


Key Responsibilities:


  • Building the brand foundation: Development and implementation of the brand book and corporate website. The website must include a functional Client Hub with technical specifications (RTP, volatility) and marketing assets for partners.
  • Go-To-Market (GTM) strategy: Development and execution of launch plans for specific regions (especially Brazil and Mexico), including localization of game content to align with cultural specifics of the markets.
  • B2B promotion and networking: Active LinkedIn development: lead generation, publishing news about signed contracts and game launches. Working with aggregators and direct outreach to operators. Preparation for participation in key exhibitions (ICE, SiGMA).
  • B2C marketing and virality: Identifying and executing bold and unconventional promotional ideas with viral potential. Building and managing a network of streamers (from micro-influencers to major stars) and affiliates. Managing social media campaigns (TikTok, Instagram Reels) to showcase gameplay and big wins.
  • Creative leadership: Providing deep context, strong hooks, and detailed briefs for the design and animation teams.


Candidate Requirements:


  • Deep expertise in iGaming: Minimum 5–10 years of experience in the industry; strong understanding of the entire ecosystem (provider — aggregator — operator — affiliate — player).
  • Knowledge of the LATAM market: Understanding of regional specifics, popular mechanics, traffic costs, and player preferences in Latin America (proven case studies in this region will be considered a strong advantage).
  • Startup mindset: Willingness to work within limited budgets, focusing on efficient organic growth strategies instead of expensive traditional campaigns.
  • Hands-on approach: At the initial stage, readiness to independently lead key processes (strategy, networking, creative briefs), with gradual team building of 3 specialists (SMM, commercial, design).
  • Creative drive: Ability not just to follow a plan, but to actively push the market and the team forward with bold ideas.


What We Offer

  • Opportunity to build an international brand from scratch within a dynamic startup environment.
  • Work in a distributed international team (Cyprus, Malta).
  • High flexibility in decision-making.
  • Minimal corporate bureaucracy.
  • Real ownership and impact from day one.

title: Senior SRE Engineer (Temporary Contract)
description:
About You

This is a high‑impact, high‑expectation senior DevOps/SRE role supporting a Private Equity Group (PEG) platform. The team is new, the infrastructure is new, and the customer is extremely selective and private.


You must operate with strong autonomy , influence engineering decisions, challenge assumptions, and serve as a thought partner rather than an order‑taker. You will work directly with VP‑level stakeholders in a technical environment where reliability, deployment safety, and clarity in communication are essential.


This position requires someone who can own DevOps architecture end‑to‑end , enable safe and frequent deployments, and establish operational excellence from day zero.


Note: This position is offered under a contractor model for a period of 6 months .


You Bring to Applaudo the Following Competencies

  • Proven ownership of production-grade CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions reusable workflows and GitOps automation with ArgoCD .
  • Expert-level Kubernetes and EKS operations , including node group management, Karpenter autoscaling, RBAC, PDBs, and topology constraints.
  • Production-scale Terraform expertise , including module design, S3 + DynamoDB remote state , and PR-driven workflows via Atlantis .
  • Strong reliability engineering experience , including SLO/SLI design, alerting strategies, dashboards, incident response, and post-incident reviews.
  • Hands-on experience operating HashiCorp Vault , including auth backends, PKI, dynamic secrets, and audit logging.
  • Experience implementing supply-chain security controls , including image scanning and signing, SBOM generation, and policy enforcement with OPA/Gatekeeper.
  • Strong experience with observability stacks , including Prometheus, Grafana, Loki, Tempo, and Alertmanager.
  • Experience with service mesh technologies such as Istio , including traffic management, mTLS, AuthorizationPolicies, and circuit breaking.
  • Scripting ability using Python and Bash for automation and operational tooling.
  • Active use of AI-assisted engineering tools such as Cursor, GitHub Copilot, or Cloud Code to accelerate IaC development, incident response, and runbook generation.
  • Strong communication skills, with the ability to communicate clearly and confidently with VP-level stakeholders during operational incidents.
  • Advanced English proficiency, as you will work directly with US-based clients.


You Will Be Accountable for the Following Responsibilities

  • Design and maintain GitHub Actions reusable workflows across a multi-repository ecosystem.
  • Own GitOps deployments through ArgoCD , including promotion workflows, sync policies, drift detection, and automated rollback strategies.
  • Implement deployment safety mechanisms such as environment protections, concurrency rules, and verification gates .
  • Operate and upgrade EKS clusters , including Karpenter provisioning, node groups, and critical cluster add-ons.
  • Maintain Terraform-driven infrastructure and enforce PR-driven workflows through Atlantis.

title: Analista Sr de Solutions
description:
Uma das pioneiras em soluções de inteligência de dados no Open Finance, a klavi é uma das instituições que mais cresce nesse ecossistema, levando inovação através de dados a milhares de brasileiros. A klavi utiliza tecnologia própria e de ponta para viabilizar a coleta de dados, além de automatizar todo o processamento desses dados para transformá-los em valor de negócio.

Estamos em busca de um(a) Analista Sênior de Projetos e Soluções com foco em compreender profundamente as necessidades dos clientes e propor alternativas estratégicas que agreguem valor ao negócio. Essa pessoa atuará de forma consultiva e colaborativa, manipulando e avaliando bases de dados para gerar insights relevantes, além de desenvolver materiais e conduzir apresentações que apoiem a tomada de decisão dos clientes. Também será responsável por interagir com os times de Sales, Dados e Risco, garantindo que as entregas sejam consistentes, assertivas e alinhadas às expectativas. O objetivo é assegurar que nossas soluções de Crédito, Market Intelligence e demais relacionadas a Open Finance, sejam eficazes, personalizadas e contribuam para o sucesso dos clientes e da empresa.

Cultura da klavi

  • Busca constante pela excelência: Somos automotivados, nunca satisfeitos e sempre buscando melhorias. Cada pessoa deve ser um especialista na empresa e em seu segmento. Nós elevamos continuamente o nível para fornecer produtos, serviços e processos de alta qualidade.
  • Inovar para revolucionar: Encorajamos as pessoas a serem curiosas e a desafiarem o status quo. Ouvimos sempre novas ideias e estamos abertos a perguntas. Não temos medo de mudanças.
  • Construção e valorização coletiva: Colabore com seus colegas e celebrem juntos as vitórias. Sejam transparentes, respeitosos e confiem uns nos outros. Nós não reclamamos, mas encontramos soluções juntos.
  • Foco no sucesso do cliente: Nosso sucesso está enraizado no sucesso dos nossos clientes. Sempre nos esforçamos para superar suas expectativas. Buscamos fornecer as melhores soluções e valores a longo prazo.

Salário

  • Regime: PJ
  • Salário: 12.000
  • Nível: Analista Sr (N4)

Principais responsabilidades

  • Identificar necessidades e oportunidades dos clientes em parceria com a equipe de Vendas, sob a ótica técnica.
  • Propor soluções práticas e relevantes que demonstrem o valor do Open Finance.
  • Definir escopo de projetos junto ao cliente, realizar manipulação e análise de dados, além de preparar e apresentar materiais.
  • Colaborar com equipes internas como Vendas, Dados, Risco e Produto para garantir alinhamento e eficiência.
  • Assegurar qualidade e consistência em todas as entregas.

Requisitos necessários:

  • Conhecimento de todo o ciclo de Crédito
  • Conhecimento em desenvolvimento de modelos, conceitos e estatísticas associadas
  • Experiência em manipulação de grandes volumes de dados, preferencialmente com o uso de Python
  • Experiência em uso do pacote Office, principalmente Excel e Power Point
  • Perfil hands-on e proativo
  • Inglês avançado
  • Boa comunicação

Nossos benefícios:

  • Plano de saúde, Plano Odontológico e Seguro de Vida;
  • Flash benefícios: Vale Refeição, Alimentação e Auxílio Home Office;
  • Licença Parental estendida: a licença maternidade é de 6 meses e a licença parental é de 30 dias;
  • Auxílio Creche;
  • Incentivo a educação;
  • Gympass;
  • Day Off aniversário;
  • Chat GPT Pro;
  • Bônus.

Etapas

  • Etapa 1: Avaliação do currículo. Capriche as atividades que você já executou;
  • Etapa 2 : Primeira Conversa com RH sobre a vaga;
  • Etapa 3 : Case Técnico;
  • Etapa 4 : Entrevistas com a área de Dados (provavelmente 3 entrevistas);
  • Etapa 5 : Fase de referência;
  • Etapa 6 : Contratação.

title: Analista Sr de Solutions
description:
Uma das pioneiras em soluções de inteligência de dados no Open Finance, a klavi é uma das instituições que mais cresce nesse ecossistema, levando inovação através de dados a milhares de brasileiros. A klavi utiliza tecnologia própria e de ponta para viabilizar a coleta de dados, além de automatizar todo o processamento desses dados para transformá-los em valor de negócio.

Estamos em busca de um(a) Analista Sênior de Projetos e Soluções com foco em compreender profundamente as necessidades dos clientes e propor alternativas estratégicas que agreguem valor ao negócio. Essa pessoa atuará de forma consultiva e colaborativa, manipulando e avaliando bases de dados para gerar insights relevantes, além de desenvolver materiais e conduzir apresentações que apoiem a tomada de decisão dos clientes. Também será responsável por interagir com os times de Sales, Dados e Risco, garantindo que as entregas sejam consistentes, assertivas e alinhadas às expectativas. O objetivo é assegurar que nossas soluções de Crédito, Market Intelligence e demais relacionadas a Open Finance, sejam eficazes, personalizadas e contribuam para o sucesso dos clientes e da empresa.

Cultura da klavi

  • Busca constante pela excelência: Somos automotivados, nunca satisfeitos e sempre buscando melhorias. Cada pessoa deve ser um especialista na empresa e em seu segmento. Nós elevamos continuamente o nível para fornecer produtos, serviços e processos de alta qualidade.
  • Inovar para revolucionar: Encorajamos as pessoas a serem curiosas e a desafiarem o status quo. Ouvimos sempre novas ideias e estamos abertos a perguntas. Não temos medo de mudanças.
  • Construção e valorização coletiva: Colabore com seus colegas e celebrem juntos as vitórias. Sejam transparentes, respeitosos e confiem uns nos outros. Nós não reclamamos, mas encontramos soluções juntos.
  • Foco no sucesso do cliente: Nosso sucesso está enraizado no sucesso dos nossos clientes. Sempre nos esforçamos para superar suas expectativas. Buscamos fornecer as melhores soluções e valores a longo prazo.

Salário

  • Regime: PJ
  • Salário: 12.000
  • Nível: Analista Sr (N4)

Principais responsabilidades

  • Identificar necessidades e oportunidades dos clientes em parceria com a equipe de Vendas, sob a ótica técnica.
  • Propor soluções práticas e relevantes que demonstrem o valor do Open Finance.
  • Definir escopo de projetos junto ao cliente, realizar manipulação e análise de dados, além de preparar e apresentar materiais.
  • Colaborar com equipes internas como Vendas, Dados, Risco e Produto para garantir alinhamento e eficiência.
  • Assegurar qualidade e consistência em todas as entregas.

Requisitos necessários:

  • Conhecimento de todo o ciclo de Crédito
  • Conhecimento em desenvolvimento de modelos, conceitos e estatísticas associadas
  • Experiência em manipulação de grandes volumes de dados, preferencialmente com o uso de Python
  • Experiência em uso do pacote Office, principalmente Excel e Power Point
  • Perfil hands-on e proativo
  • Inglês avançado
  • Boa comunicação

Nossos benefícios:

  • Plano de saúde, Plano Odontológico e Seguro de Vida;
  • Flash benefícios: Vale Refeição, Alimentação e Auxílio Home Office;
  • Licença Parental estendida: a licença maternidade é de 6 meses e a licença parental é de 30 dias;
  • Auxílio Creche;
  • Incentivo a educação;
  • Gympass;
  • Day Off aniversário;
  • Chat GPT Pro;
  • Bônus.

Etapas

  • Etapa 1: Avaliação do currículo. Capriche as atividades que você já executou;
  • Etapa 2 : Primeira Conversa com RH sobre a vaga;
  • Etapa 3 : Case Técnico;
  • Etapa 4 : Entrevistas com a área de Dados (provavelmente 3 entrevistas);
  • Etapa 5 : Fase de referência;
  • Etapa 6 : Contratação.

title: Business Analyst - 100% Remote
description:
At Cibernos , we are looking for talent to work with a company in the software and cybersecurity sector , specializing in digital brand protection, corporate domain portfolio management, and securing the online presence of global organizations.

We are seeking a Business Analyst who will act as the link between business stakeholders, the Product Owner, and engineering teams to support the delivery of high-quality SaaS solutions.



Responsibilities

  • Gather and document business and functional requirements.
  • Translate business needs into user stories and acceptance criteria .
  • Work closely with the Product Owner to refine the product backlog .
  • Facilitate communication between stakeholders and engineering teams.
  • Participate in Agile ceremonies and validate that delivered solutions meet business requirements.


Requirements

  • Experience as a Business Analyst in technology, SaaS, or cybersecurity environments.
  • Experience working with Agile/Scrum methodologies .
  • Ability to document functional requirements and collaborate with engineering teams.
  • Basic knowledge of cloud environments (preferably AWS) .
  • Strong analytical and communication skills.
  • Professional English proficiency .


Benefits

  • Statutory life insurance and disability coverage.
  • Workers’ compensation coverage.
  • Statutory sickness and family-related benefits.
  • Transportation allowance (vale-transporte ).
  • Food or meal allowance.
  • Pension benefits through Brazil’s social security system.
  • Access to public healthcare (SUS ).
  • 100% remote work model.



If this opportunity matches your experience and career goals, we encourage you to apply and join our growing international team.

title: Editorial Graphic Designer (Interiors + Spaces)
description:
So… who the heck is Residence Supply?


I'm Jacky, the founder. We started as a local lighting brand obsessed with historical architecture and heirloom craftsmanship. In just a few years we blew past 8 figures, launched hundreds of handcrafted SKUs, and built a cult following of design-obsessed homeowners. Our fixtures live in Architectural Digest–worthy homes.


Now we're building the ULTIMATE creative team. One that takes us from \"fastest-growing DTC brand\" to category-defining design house. We need a graphic designer who doesn't just execute... but one who sees the world the way our customers do. Through the lens of beauty, heritage, and taste.


What You'll Do

  • Design editorial ads that feel like they were pulled from a print magazine
  • Translate interior design trends and RS products into visual stories that stop the scroll
  • Build mood boards and visual direction decks to guide campaigns
  • Maintain and elevate brand visual consistency across every creative touchpoint
  • Collaborate with our Creative Strategist, Content team, and Founder on campaign ideation
  • QC all outgoing creative. Nothing ships unless it looks like Residence Supply


Who You Are

  • 3+ years designing for high-end lifestyle, interiors, fashion, or luxury DTC brands
  • Your portfolio looks like a coffee table book, not a social media dump
  • Obsessed with typography, white space, negative space, and editorial composition
  • You follow interior designers, architects, and design publications
  • Proficient in Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign)
  • You understand the difference between beautiful and effective
  • Architecture or interior design background? You're already shortlisted.


What We're Building

Residence Supply is not trying to be another ecommerce brand. We're becoming a heritage-driven design house growing 100% year over year. This role will define the visual language that new customers judge us by. Your work will live in catalogs, on Pinterest boards of people building their dream homes, and in the feeds of the most design-literate buyers in the country.


This is your chance to join a founding creative team before the rocket takes off.


What We're Offering

  • Competitive Salary
  • 10 days PTO per year
  • Opportunity to grow into creative strategist/lead graphic designer
  • Fully remote


How to Apply

Don't send us a generic application. Send us:

  • A portfolio or 3–5 pieces you're most proud of... especially anything editorial, catalog, or interiors-adjacent please!
  • A quick paragraph on how you'd approach the visual feel of a Residence Supply print catalog
  • Tell us: what brand's visual identity do you wish you had built and why?


If the interview goes well, we hire on the call. Good luck.

title: Software Application Engineer
description:
***Please send your CV in English


About Foretellix:

Foretellix is the gold standard for data-driven autonomy development toolchains. Foretellix’s Foretify™ toolchain enables a measurable, efficient, and trusted path to safe and scalable autonomy that helps you launch with confidence. Building on its industry leading V&V technology, Foretellix is enabling the AI autonomy revolution.


Role Description:

Be part of the Application Engineering Team responsible for adapting and deploying Foretellix verification & validation solutions to our customers and making them successful at their mission to provide next-gen ADAS/AV products. Our Application Engineers have a unique mix of ADAS/AV domain knowledge, software expertise, creativity, and the ability to work closely with customers to maximize the impact our solution can have on their ability to deliver high quality, safe products.


What will you do:

  • Deploy the Foretellix solution at customer accounts. From tools installation and integration, customer training and ramp-up, to defining the V&V strategy, including both remote and on-site support.
  • Shape our products by being the primary point of contact between the customer and R&D. Understand the customer’s V&V challenges and translate them into product requirements to help improve the products.
  • Work with the sales team as the technical product expert to develop and deliver demos and presentations to customers, as well as guide and support customer product evaluations.
  • When required, create application notes, methodology documents, and technical presentations.


Requirements:

  • At least 3 years of industry working experience, ideally in the ADAS/AV domain.
  • Knowledge in Software Engineering, including OO programming, testing, and debugging.
  • BSc or above in the areas of Computer Science, Automotive Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Robotics, or other related fields.
  • Have excellent human relationship skills
  • Be communicative and fluent in English, both verbal and in writing.
  • Be a team-player, resourceful, and professional.


Advantages:

  • Experience in ADAS/AV V&V, testing, and simulation.
  • Previous experience in customer facing engineering such as Field Application Engineering, Sales Engineering, Professional Services, or related positions.
  • Running and working with ADAS/AV Simulators, e.g. Carla, Sumo, Carmaker, Vires, etc...
  • Employee in one of the ADAS/AV companies, or one of the companies serving them.
  • Previous experience as a Product Manager / Methodology Engineer.
  • Knowledge & experience with ADAS/AV verification.
  • Knowledge & experience with advanced verification, and specifically with Specman and the ‘e’ language, and/or SystemVerilog UVM, Perspec PSS, and Coverage Driven Verification.
  • MSc or above in the areas of Computer Science, Automotive Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Robotics, or other related fields.
  • Substantial experience in Software Engineering, including OO programming.

title: [Tech] Especialista em Desenvolvimento Full Stack - .Net
description:
Descrição da vaga

Você terá a oportunidade de impactar diretamente o setor RH. Buscamos um(a) Especialista Full Stack com foco em IA com forte visão de arquitetura e inovação, que será responsável pela gestão e operação de um Consultor digital, atuando como ponto focal para iniciativas de experimentação e aplicação de tecnologias de IA. Este profissional terá como missão fomentar a cultura de IA, promover o uso ético e estratégico da IA, e apoiar colaboradores e equipes na exploração de soluções inteligentes que agreguem valor ao negócio.


Responsabilidades e atribuições:

  • Propor soluções conceituais e orientar a implementação de projetos de IA;
  • Experiência prática em projetos de IA, Machine Learning, Deep Learning, Processamento de Linguagem Natural e/ou Visão Computacional;
  • Familiaridade com as capacidades e limitações da IA Generativa (ex: LLMs);
  • Integração de modelos de linguagem (LLMs) com APIs e sistemas legados;
  • Conhecimento prático de IA generativa e suas aplicações em negócios;
  • Integrar soluções de IA a sistemas corporativos de ERP, atuando no desenvolvimento back-end e front-end;
  • Implementar e validar POCs (provas de conceito) de novas tecnologias e soluções;
  • Garantir qualidade, segurança, performance e escalabilidade das soluções;
  • Visão sistêmica: entender impactos das decisões técnicas no ecossistema como um todo;
  • Trabalhar em conjunto com a Squad conforme os processos ágeis definidos pela empresa, com objetivo de atingir as metas do time;
  • Garantir que as entregas estão em conformidade com as boas práticas e convenções internas;
  • Desenvolver Testes Unitários, Testes Automatizados e Documentar funcionalidades desenvolvidas;
  • Orientar e atuar junto ao time de desenvolvimento na definição de soluções de negócio e arquitetura, por meio de pesquisas e trocas de conhecimento com áreas parceiras.Manter a qualidade do software verificando os processos, ferramentas e boas práticas disponíveis para o produto e tecnologia utilizados;
  • Orientar desenvolvedores de menor senioridade apoiando suas dúvidas, disseminando seu conhecimento, desenhando e arquitetando soluções ou indicando documentação de apoio.


Requisitos e qualificações:

  • Boa lógica de programação e princípios SOLID;
  • Conhecimento em Back-end (c#, .Net, Advpl);
  • Conhecimento em Front-end (Angular/TypeScript);
  • Graduação completa em Computação, Engenharia, Dados ou áreas correlatas;
  • Domínio de IA/ML (NLP, LLMs, classificação e extração de entidades) e capacidade analítica para traduzir problemas de negócio em soluções de IA;
  • Engenharia de prompts, MCP, RAG, pipelines, modelos supervisionados e não supervisionados;
  • Experiência com projetos de IA Generativa;
  • Banco de Dados: SQL e NoSQL;
  • Controle de Versão: Git e ferramentas associadas (Repos, GitHub, GitLab);
  • APIs e configuração e manutenção de pipelines de CI/CD;
  • Noções de segurança da informação e boas práticas para desenvolvimento seguro;
  • Conhecimento em Processo Ágil, DevOps e plataformas Cloud (Azure).


Requisitos desejáveis:

  • Conhecimento em Protheus;
  • Conhecimento em PO-UI.

title: Médico Especialista em Demência – Papel Consultivo (Dedicação Parcial)
description:
Sobre a Kuidar+

A Kuidar+ está desenvolvendo um modelo estruturado de coordenação de cuidados em demência , apoiado por tecnologia, para famílias que convivem com Alzheimer e outras demências no Brasil.

Nosso programa atua entre as consultas médicas , oferecendo monitoramento contínuo, suporte ao cuidador, coordenação de telemedicina e navegação estruturada do cuidado. A plataforma combina protocolos clínicos, ferramentas digitais, telemonitoramento e apoio baseado em inteligência artificial para ajudar famílias a lidar com os desafios médicos, comportamentais e práticos da demência.

O modelo é inspirado em iniciativas internacionais de coordenação de cuidado em demência, como o GUIDE Model (EUA) , adaptado ao contexto brasileiro.

Estamos atualmente em fase piloto , construindo o primeiro modelo operacional do programa e formando o primeiro Care Pod da Kuidar+.


Sobre a função

Buscamos um médico(a) com experiência em demência para atuar como Médico Advisor da Kuidar+ em regime de dedicação parcial.

Esta não é uma posição assistencial e não envolve consultas ou atendimento médico direto aos pacientes.


O papel combina dois objetivos principais:


Governança clínica

Apoiar a validação clínica do modelo de cuidado, garantindo que protocolos, critérios de triagem e fluxos de segurança estejam alinhados às melhores práticas no cuidado de pessoas com demência.


Desenvolvimento do modelo de cuidado

Contribuir para o desenho e evolução do modelo de coordenação de cuidados da Kuidar+, incluindo o uso de telemedicina, monitoramento remoto e ferramentas baseadas em inteligência artificial .

O profissional poderá ser apresentado publicamente como Clinical Advisor da Kuidar+ , contribuindo para a construção da arquitetura clínica do programa.

Com a evolução da empresa, poderá também participar de discussões estratégicas relacionadas ao desenvolvimento clínico da plataforma e do modelo de cuidado .


Responsabilidades

  • Revisar e validar protocolos clínicos utilizados no programa
  • Contribuir para a definição de critérios de triagem e escalonamento clínico
  • Oferecer orientação à equipe multidisciplinar em situações clínicas mais complexas
  • Participar de revisões periódicas de casos

title: Business Development Representative
description:
Eracore is an electrical engineering and BIM company delivering complex Electrical BIM models for large construction projects across the U.S. Our team brings together top talent to work on some of the most interesting and technically demanding electrical projects including data centers, government facilities, industrial buildings, and advanced commercial projects.


We are proud of the work we do, and we invite you to take a look:


Role Overview

We are looking for a Business Development Representative (BDR) / Sales Representative to drive outbound sales and generate new business opportunities. The ideal candidate will be responsible for prospecting, outreach, and lead generation, helping expand our client base for software and engineering services.


Key Responsibilities

  • Identify and prospect potential clients through LinkedIn, email outreach, cold calling, and other outbound channels
  • Build and manage a pipeline of qualified leads
  • Conduct initial discovery calls to understand client needs
  • Schedule meetings and demos for senior sales or technical teams
  • Maintain CRM records and track outreach activities
  • Collaborate with marketing and sales teams to improve outreach strategies
  • Research target industries and companies to identify potential opportunities
  • Achieve and exceed monthly lead generation and pipeline targets


Requirements

  • 2+ years experience in business development, sales, or lead generation
  • Experience in B2B outbound sales
  • Strong communication and negotiation skills
  • Experience using CRM tools (HubSpot, Salesforce, etc.)
  • Ability to manage high-volume outreach campaigns
  • Self-motivated with strong organizational skills

title: Analista de Planejamento de Obras
description:
Quem é a Urbem ?

Unindo tecnologia e industrialização a uma matéria-prima renovável, trazemos para o Brasil a madeira engenheirada, alternativa construtiva que contribui para solucionar as dores da construção civil. Estamos falando de um canteiro de obras mais produtivo, previsível, sem geração de resíduos, mais rápido e seguro. Já pensou?


Somos a face de uma nova relação entre empresas, meio ambiente e pessoas. Com projetos íntegros, que nascem no campo e constroem nossas cidades.


Valorizamos a diversidade e promovemos a inclusão a partir de compromissos que impulsionam o desenvolvimento humano sustentável, a criatividade e a inovação.


Nosso ambiente é diverso, onde pessoas de todos os gêneros, raça, idade, orientação sexual e com deficiência escolhem para se desenvolver como pessoa e profissional.


O que esperamos de você?

Estamos em busca de pessoas para serem protagonistas de uma nova dinâmica que

conecta florestas a cidades. Que queiram se desenvolver e aprender constantemente, compartilhando, colaborando, inovando e entregando valor para todos os nossos clientes.


Temos certeza que uma de nossas oportunidades vai dar um “match” com você!


Confira abaixo as as atividades que estão sob a responsabilidade da posição de Analista de Planejamento de Obras :

  • Elaborar e manter atualizados os cronogramas físico-financeiros das obras, definindo etapas, prazos e sequenciamento das atividades.
  • Planejar e acompanhar a execução das atividades de obra, verificando o progresso em relação ao planejamento.
  • Controlar o avanço físico da obra, comparando o realizado com o planejado e identificando desvios.
  • Elaborar e atualizar relatórios de acompanhamento de obras, apresentando indicadores de prazo, custos e produtividade.
  • Apoiar na definição de planos de ação para correção de atrasos ou desvios de execução.
  • Realizar medições de serviços executados e apoiar o controle de contratos com fornecedores e prestadores de serviço.
  • Integrar informações entre as áreas de engenharia, suprimentos, produção, financeiro e execução da obra.
  • Apoiar o planejamento de recursos necessários para a obra, como materiais, equipamentos e mão de obra.
  • Monitorar riscos relacionados à execução da obra e propor medidas de mitigação.


O que você precisa ter?

  • Ensino superior completo ou em andamento em Engenharia Civil, Engenharia de Produção, Arquitetura ou áreas correlatas.
  • Domínio Excel como ferramentas de planejamento e controle de gestão de obras.
  • Vivência no ramo de construção civil.
  • Experiência com planejamento e controle de obras.
  • Conhecimento em cronograma físico-financeiro e leitura de projetos.
  • Organização, planejamento e senso de prioridade.
  • Disposição para aprender e encarar desafios.


E aí, vamos construir as cidades do futuro, juntos?

Vem ser URBEM .

title: Contact Center Executive - Customer Service
description:
About Us:


HBX Group is the world’s leading technology partner, connecting and empowering the world of travel. We’re game-changers, disruptors, the people who bring together local and global brands in accommodation, transport, activities and payments through our network of 300,000 hotels worldwide, 60,000 hard to reach high value clients such as tour operators, travel agents and loyalty schemes across 140 source markets. We are tech-driven, with a customer-first philosophy, and commercial teams whose knowledge and relationships on the ground are second to none. And of course we have an amazing team! Our people, Team HBX Group, are the beating heart of the company who we encourage to ‘move fast, dream big and make the difference’ every day. In fact, we believe that it is tech + data + people that truly sets us apart in the market, alongside our ‘global approach, local touch’ mentality. We’re headquartered in Palma, Mallorca and employ around 3,500 people worldwide.


We are seeking a Global Contact Center Executive to join our dynamic Contact Center team. In this role, you will support our clients and suppliers, contributing to one of our core missions: delivering unique holiday experiences to our customers . This opportunity is open to candidates currently residing in Jundiaí .


Role Overview

The primary responsibility of this role is to assist clients—including tour operators, travel agencies, and end customers—with their inquiries, liaise with suppliers, and manage bookings in alignment with the standards and procedures of the Operations Department. The goal is to address client needs efficiently and effectively.


Key Responsibilities

  • Engage with callers in a professional and enthusiastic manner, representing HBX Group with excellence.
  • Provide accurate and helpful information in response to client inquiries.
  • Document all call activity clearly and accurately in the Back Office system.
  • Respond promptly and precisely to online and email requests.
  • Monitor and manage bookings, including reservations, special requests, amendments, and cancellations.
  • Escalate issues appropriately, following Contact Center protocols.
  • Maintain high standards of service quality and professionalism.
  • Meet established Service Level Agreements (SLAs) and Key Performance Indicators (KPIs).
  • Adhere to all company policies and procedures.
  • Follow assigned schedules and adapt to changes based on call volume.


Required Skills and Qualifications

  • Strong customer service orientation and active listening skills.
  • Proficiency in English (spoken and written).
  • Excellent verbal and written communication, with attention to grammar and clarity.
  • Problem-solving mindset with persistence in resolving issues accurately and efficiently.
  • Ability to follow detailed instructions independently.
  • High attention to detail and adaptability.
  • Consistent focus and enthusiasm throughout the work shift.


If you are passionate about customer service, communication, and creative problem-solving, we encourage you to apply today!


Note: Only candidates currently living in Jundiaí will be considered for this position in the Hybrid Model.



At HBX Group, we believe that diversity drives innovation and makes travel a force for good. We're committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone feels valued and respected, embracing different backgrounds, perspectives and talents. Join us and be part of a team where diversity and equal opportunities really do make a difference

description:
Kenvue is currently recruiting for a:

Comunidade de Talentos Kenvue – Pessoas com Deficiência (PcD)

What we do

At Kenvue, we realize the extraordinary power of everyday care. Built on over a century of heritage and rooted in science, we’re the house of iconic brands - including NEUTROGENA®, AVEENO®, TYLENOL®, LISTERINE®, JOHNSON’S® and BAND-AID® that you already know and love. Science is our passion; care is our talent.

Who We Are

Our global team is ~ 22,000 brilliant people with a workplace culture where every voice matters, and every contribution is appreciated.  We are passionate about insights, innovation and committed to delivering the best products to our customers. With expertise and empathy, being a Kenvuer means having the power to impact millions of people every day. We put people first, care fiercely, earn trust with science and solve with courage – and have brilliant opportunities waiting for you! Join us in shaping our future–and yours. For more information, click here.

Role reports to:

LIDER REG REC E SELECAO

Location:

Latin America, Brazil, Sao Paulo, Sao Paulo

Work Location:

Hybrid

What you will do

Comunidade de Talentos Kenvue – Pessoas com Deficiência (PcD)

Local:  Brasil
Departamento:  Vários
Regime de contratação:  Inclusão - Período integral

O que nós fazemos

Na Kenvue, reconhecemos o poder extraordinário do cuidado diário. Com mais de um século de tradição e com foco na ciência, somos o lar de marcas icônicas – como NEUTROGENA®, LISTERINE®, TYLENOL®, JOHNSON’S BABY® e BAND-AID® – que você já conhece e ama. A ciência é a nossa paixão; o cuidado, o nosso talento.

Quem somos

Nosso time global é formado por ~ 22.000 pessoas brilhantes, em uma cultura na qual cada voz importa e toda contribuição é valorizada. Somos movidos por insights, inovação e pelo compromisso de entregar os melhores produtos aos nossos consumidores. Com expertise e empatia, ser um Kenvuer é ter o poder de impactar milhões de vidas todos os dias. Colocamos as pessoas em primeiro lugar, cuidamos com paixão, ganhamos confiança por meio da ciência e resolvemos com coragem — e temos oportunidades incríveis esperando por você! Junte-se a nós para construir o nosso futuro — e o seu.

Sobre a Comunidade de Talentos PCD Kenvue

Na Kenvue, todas as nossas vagas já são abertas para todas as pessoas! Temos o compromisso de promover um ambiente inclusivo e acolhemos candidaturas de quem quer fazer parte da nossa jornada de cuidado diário.

A Comunidade de Talentos PCD Kenvue é uma iniciativa complementar, especialmente para fortalecer nossa conexão com pessoas com deficiência que queiram desenvolver suas carreiras conosco. Ao se inscrever aqui, você entra para a nossa Comunidade de Talentos Para Pessoas Com Deficiência, e o nosso time de Recrutamento entrará em contato com você sempre que existirem vagas alinhadas às suas experiências, interesses e objetivos de carreira. 

O que você vai fazer

O seu perfil será considerado para funções na Kenvue de acordo com as suas experiências, interesses e habilidades. Temos posições em diferentes áreas e senioridades nos escritórios de São Paulo e São José dos Campos/SP, vagas virtuais e posições de campo em todo Brasil.

Qualificações mínimas:
  • Ensino superior completo
  • Familiaridade com ferramentas digitais (pacote Office)
  • Vontade de crescer e aprender em ambientes operacionais e administrativos
  • Fortes habilidades de comunicação e de trabalho em equipe
  • Compromisso em manter um ambiente de trabalho seguro e de alta qualidade
Qualificações desejáveis:
  • Experiência prévia em campos relevantes
  • Inglês avançado
Por que fazer parte da nossa Comunidade de Talentos PCD
  • Pacote de Benefícios Competitivo*
  • Feriados pagos pela empresa, férias remuneradas, tempo para voluntariado e muito mais!
  • Oportunidades de Aprendizado e Desenvolvimento
  • Redes de Impacto da Kenvue

*Essa lista pode variar de acordo com a localização e modelo de trabalho.

Nota:  Total Rewards da Kenvue inclui salário, bônus (quando aplicável) e benefícios. Seu parceiro de Talent Access poderá compartilhar mais detalhes sobre nosso pacote completo de recompensas e a faixa salarial específica para a(s) localidade(s) relevante(s) durante o processo de recrutamento e contratação.

A Kenvue tem orgulho de ser uma empregadora que oferece igualdade de oportunidades. Todas as pessoas qualificadas que se candidatarem serão considerados para as vagas independentemente de raça, cor, religião, sexo, orientação sexual, identidade de gênero, idade, nacionalidade ou deficiência.

If you are an individual with a disability, please check our Disability Assistance page for information on how to request an accommodation.

title: Data Scientist - Remote - Talent Pool
description:
We’re building a talent pool for Senior Data Scientist Engineers . This pipeline role is for engineers with strong SQL and Python experience . This position plays a key role in supporting product decision-making through data analysis, reporting, and business intelligence.


What You’ll Do

  • Help clear existing backlog and enhance the team’s data infrastructure and analytics capabilities.
  • Work with ETL processes, analytics, and BI tools to drive actionable insights.
  • Create and maintain data pipelines and workflows using Airflow.
  • Perform data cleaning, transformation, and combination of existing data tables in Snowflake.
  • Collaborate closely with product and engineering teams to deliver accurate reporting and analytics.
  • Contribute to Streamlit dashboards and analytical tools.


What We’re Looking For

  • Proven experience with Python and SQL in a data-focused environment.
  • Familiarity with data tools such as Airflow, Snowflake, and Streamlit.
  • Strong understanding of analytics best practices and product data workflows.
  • Basic knowledge or interest in cryptocurrencies, blockchain technology, and ERC-20 tokens.
  • Excellent communication skills in English, both written and verbal.
  • Ability to work effectively across time zones with overlap to US hours (preferably Eastern Time).


Nice to Have

  • Prior experience in fintech, payments, or digital assets.
  • Understanding of blockchain data structures or related crypto analytics.


Why Join Kake?

Kake is a remote-first company with a global community — fully believing that it’s not where your table is, but what you bring to the table that matters. We provide top-tier engineering teams to support some of the world’s most innovative companies, and we’ve built a culture where great people stay, grow, and thrive. We’re proud to be more than just a stop along the way in your career — we’re the destination.


The icing on the Kake:

Competitive Pay in USD – Work globally, get paid globally.

Fully Remote – Simply put, we trust you.

Better Me Fund – We invest in your personal growth and passions.

❤️ Compassion is Badass – Join a community that invests in social good.

title: Finance Business Partner | Accounts Receivable
description:
About Pinnacle Group

Pinnacle Group is a leading workforce solutions and technology services provider delivering innovative, results-driven solutions to global enterprises. With deep expertise in financial operations, staffing models, and program management, we help organizations optimize performance while maintaining strong compliance and operational excellence. Our finance team plays a critical role in supporting scalable growth, operational efficiency, and exceptional client experiences across diverse programs.


Summary

The Finance Business Partner will lead Pinnacle Group’s Accounts Receivable operations while serving as a strategic advisor to client-facing business teams. This role is approximately 70% operational, overseeing billing, collections, reconciliations, supplier payments, and team performance, and 30% focused on financial partnership and business support. The ideal candidate will bring strong leadership, analytical expertise, and a client-service mindset to improve AR performance and drive financial excellence. This position is instrumental in ensuring accurate cash flow management, client satisfaction, and continuous process improvement.


Job Description


Accounts Receivable Management

  • Oversee the full AR lifecycle including invoicing, collections, reconciliations, dispute resolution, and aging analysis.
  • Ensure accurate and timely billing while resolving client exceptions efficiently.
  • Monitor client payments, oversee cash application, and ensure timely settlement reconciliation to support 100% on-time supplier payment SLAs.
  • Partner with Accounts Payable and Treasury to align receivables with cash flow forecasts and payment schedules.
  • Monitor receivables aging and collaborate with client stakeholders and PMO teams to resolve payment inquiries.
  • Manage quarterly client and supplier volume rebates with precision and compliance.
  • Standardize AR policies, procedures, and playbooks across programs while maintaining audit readiness and strong internal controls.
  • Drive automation and continuous improvement initiatives to enhance AR efficiency and scalability.


Finance Business Partnering

  • Serve as the primary finance liaison to program leaders and account managers, supporting invoice-related issue resolution.
  • Provide actionable insights on billing behaviors, dispute trends, and invoicing challenges to improve program performance.
  • Present tailored AR reporting to leadership, highlighting risks, opportunities, and business impact.
  • Support onboarding of new client programs with structured billing guidance and financial playbooks.
  • Collaborate with Legal and Contracts to align billing terms and resolve disputes effectively.
  • Handle sensitive financial matters with discretion, urgency, and professionalism.


Team Management & Development

  • Lead and mentor a team of 2–4 AR analysts across onshore and offshore locations.
  • Manage hiring, training, workload distribution, and performance management in coordination with leadership.
  • Track and analyze AR KPIs including on-time billing, payment application, supplier payment SLAs, and resolution timelines.
  • Foster a culture of accountability, innovation, and proactive problem-solving.
  • Design and implement development plans to enhance team autonomy and operational excellence.


Technology & Systems

  • Manage AR modules within Workday and collaborate on system enhancements and integrations.
  • Review testing outcomes for system updates and approve AR-related production releases.
  • Contribute to the AR technology roadmap to support automation and process optimization initiatives.


Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Business, or related field.
  • Minimum 5 years of management experience in Accounts Receivable or related financial operations.
  • Strong knowledge of US GAAP and accounting principles.
  • Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel including pivot tables, VLOOKUPs, and data analysis.
  • Experience with Workday or other ERP/accounting systems.
  • Experience in the staffing industry or Pay-When-Paid programs preferred.
  • Proven leadership experience managing diverse teams and driving measurable performance improvements.
  • Excellent communication skills with the ability to translate financial data into business insights.


Why Join Pinnacle Group?

At Pinnacle Group, you will play a strategic role in shaping financial operations that directly impact business growth and client success. We foster a collaborative, high-performance culture where innovation, accountability, and continuous improvement are valued. This role offers significant visibility across business leadership, opportunities to influence process transformation, and the ability to build and develop a strong finance team. If you are driven by operational excellence and strategic impact, Pinnacle Group offers a platform to grow your leadership career.

description:
Project Description:

Founded in 1984, our client is one of the world's leading provider of lithography systems for the semiconductor industry, manufacturing complex machines that are critical to the production of integrated circuits or chips. The client has its R&D and manufacturing operations in The Netherlands.

Luxoft is currently searching to augment the Development & Engineering Department with a talented software engineer to design and implement embedded software for systems among the highest precision ever produced in the world.


Responsibilities:

  • As a software engineer, you will be working on Linux server applications for metrology components and on complex algorithms application software. You will be working with electrical engineers, mechatronic engineers and system engineers to define the software requirements.
  • A team of about 10 people consisting of a team lead, a sw architect, a few senior developers. After your SW design is approved you are responsible for implementing the design in Python & C for new modules.
  • During testing, you will collect the necessary data so you can write a test report.
  • The development environment is Red Hat Linux, execution environment is Wind River Linux. The software release driving a client machine is 40 million lines of code. Client SW teams work in various modes such as Agile and SAFE.


Mandatory Skills Description:

  • We are looking for colleagues with at least 5 years of development experience.
  • Python: application coding
  • Linux (one of more of the following): familiar with command line tools, makefile, git, shell and python scripting
  • Embedded C and C++: understanding and maintaining legacy code. Adding new features while keeping compliance with established architecture.
  • Version control using command line is also required - Git, Clear Case and SVN, in this order of priority.


Languages:

  • English: C1 Advanced

Em 2006, surge a brMalls resultando em um portfólio de 30 ativos presentes nas cinco regiões do país.

E assim, em 2023, a ALLOS surge com o encontro de duas potências nacionais do segmento, unindo forças para se tornar a mais inovadora plataforma de entretenimento, lifestyle, serviços e compras.

Nossa história continua e estamos prontos para criar momentos que transformam e impactam a vida das pessoas, gerando conexões e oportunidades.

Você irá implementar, acompanhar, avaliar e manter programas de proteção e promoção à saúde em consonância com os objetivos e metas estabelecidos pela Siemens Energy.

  • Auxiliar na prevenção e promoção da saúde dos trabalhadores através da implementação do Programa de Controle Médico de Saúde Ocupacional (PCMSO).

Sobre a equipe  
 

Fará parte da equipe local de saúde, apoiando as atividades Brasil, com interface com equipes LATAM e Global. 

Quem é a Siemens Energy?  

Na Siemens Energy, somos mais do que apenas uma empresa de tecnologia de energia. Com ~100,000 funcionários dedicados em mais de 90 países, desenvolvemos os sistemas de energia do futuro, assegurando que a crescente demanda energética da comunidade global seja atendida de forma confiável e sustentável. As tecnologias criadas pelos nossos departamentos de pesquisa e pelas nossas fábricas impulsionam a transição energética e fornecem a base para um sexto da geração de eletricidade mundial.  

Nossa equipe global está comprometida em tornar realidade a energia sustentável, confiável e acessível ultrapassando as barreiras do que é possível. Temos um legado de 150 anos de inovação que incentiva nossa busca por pessoas que ajudarão em nosso foco na descarbonização, em novas tecnologias e na transformação energética. 

Saiba como você pode fazer a diferença na Siemens Energy:   

Nosso compromisso com a diversidade 

Para nossa sorte, não somos todos iguais. Através da diversidade geramos energia. Trabalhamos com inclusão e nossa energia criativa combinada é alimentada por mais de 130 nacionalidades. A Siemens Energy celebra o caráter, independentemente de origem étnica, sexo, idade, religião, identidade ou deficiência. Energizamos a sociedade, toda a sociedade, e não discriminamos por causa de nossas diferenças.

title: Tech Lead Fullstack- Node/React
description:
Principais Responsabilidades

2.1. Arquitetura e Estratégia Técnica

● Definição de Soluções: Decidir sobre a estrutura do software, stacks tecnológicos e frameworks, assegurando que as escolhas atendam aos requisitos funcionais e não-funcionais (performance, segurança, escalabilidade).

● Visão de Longo Prazo: Garantir que as decisões técnicas atuais não criem dívida técnica insustentável e estejam alinhadas com os objetivos gerais da empresa.

● Análise de Viabilidade: Avaliar solicitações de produto sob a ótica técnica antes do início do desenvolvimento.

2.2. Gestão Técnica e Qualidade

● Guardião da Qualidade: Estabelecer e fiscalizar padrões de desenvolvimento (Clean Code, SOLID), fluxos de Git e estratégias de testes automatizados.

● Revisão de Código (Code Review): Atuar ativamente nos Pull Requests não apenas para aprovar, mas para garantir conformidade com a arquitetura e identificar falhas de segurança ou lógica.

● Gestão de Riscos: Identificar gargalos técnicos ou riscos de integração antecipadamente, propondo planos de mitigação.

2.3. Liderança e Mentoria (People Development)

● Mentoria Técnica: Orientar desenvolvedores (Juniores, Plenos e Seniores), ajudando-os a superar bloqueios técnicos e incentivando as melhores práticas.

● Promoção da Autonomia: Delegar tarefas complexas com supervisão, permitindo que o time cresça, evitando a centralização do conhecimento no Tech Lead.

● Apoio ao Crescimento: Fornecer feedback técnico construtivo para apoiar o desenvolvimento profissional dos membros da equipe.

2.4. Comunicação e Ponte com Negócios

● Tradução de Requisitos: Converter necessidades de negócio (do Product Manager ou Cliente) em requisitos técnicos claros e acionáveis para os desenvolvedores.

● Facilitação: Atuar como interlocutor técnico em reuniões com outras áreas ou clientes, protegendo o time de interrupções desnecessárias e clarificando dúvidas técnicas.


Requisitos



Proficiência em React (com TypeScript, Next.js, Vite, SASS, Jest) para o frontend e Node.js (com Express, NestJS, GraphQL, APIs REST) para o backend, além de bancos de dados (PostgreSQL, MongoDB), ferramentas de versionamento (Git), CI/CD (Docker, Jenkins/AWS) e soft skills como comunicação e trabalho em equipe, focando em desenvolvimento escalável, testes e boas práticas de engenharia.

title: Remote Business Analyst (German) - 54879
description:
About Turing:

Turing is one of the world’s fastest-growing AI companies accelerating the advancement and deployment of powerful AI systems.

Turing helps customers in two ways: Working with the world’s leading AI labs to advance frontier model capabilities in thinking, reasoning, coding, agentic behavior, multimodality, multilinguality, STEM and frontier knowledge; and leveraging that work to build real-world AI systems that solve mission-critical priorities for companies.


Role Overview:

We are looking for candidates with strong analytical and English comprehension skills. The ideal candidate should have the ability to read, summarize, and break down large content into smaller logical blocks, conduct research online, validate claims made in the content through online research, and work with the LLM (Large Language Models) to solve puzzles!

Your role is critical in helping fine-tune and improve large language models (like gpt), and will make you an expert on how to leverage AI to be a better analyst. This is your chance to future-proof your career in an AI-first world!


What does day-to-day look like:

You would spend time answering a variety of interesting analytical questions and creating scenarios that can train the LLM models to get better. Here are a couple of examples which models might get wrong and you would have to give the correct answer and explanation to enable the models to learn:

  • Based on a given distribution of sales by month across locations, could you analyze which location has grown the most? (Hint: what time period should we look at? should we account for sudden variability at the beginning?)
  • In a small town, there are four distinct neighborhoods: Oak, Pine, Maple, and Elm. A postman is assigned to deliver mail and can only deliver to two neighborhoods in one day, with certain rules (e.g. Oak is always visited before Pine). If he delivers to Oak and Elm on the first day, which neighborhoods does the carrier deliver to on the second day? Note: No other prior specialized domain experience is needed.


Requirements:

  • Multilingual capabilities are mandatory. (English and German)
  • Analytical Skills : Good research and analytical skills
  • Feedback Skills : Ability to provide constructive feedback and detailed annotations.
  • Creative Thinking : Creative and lateral thinking abilities.
  • Communication : Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
  • Independence : Self-motivated and able to work independently in a remote setting.
  • Commitment : Ability to commit to 40 hours per week for the contract duration overlapping US hours.
  • Technical Setup : Desktop/Laptop set up with a good internet connection.


Preferred Qualifications:

  • Bachelors degree or undergraduate in Engineering, Literature, Journalism, Communications, Arts, Statistics, or a related field. We are open to candidates who do not have a Bachelor's degree but have experience in the area.
  • Experience writing professionally (business analysts, research analyst, copywriter, journalist, technical writer, editor, translator, etc.)
  • Understanding of Excel and Google Suite.
  • Proficiency in Data interpretation, Logical reasoning and Basic arithmetic is highly desirable.


Perks of Freelancing With Turing:

  • Work in a fully remote environment.
  • Opportunity to work on cutting-edge AI projects with leading LLM companies.
  • Potential for contract extension based on performance and project needs.


Offer Details:

  • Engagement type : Contractor assignment/freelancer (no medical/paid leave)
  • Commitments Required : Availability of up to 40 hours/week is preferred. This role will require some overlap with UTC-8:00 (2-5 hrs/day) America/Los_Angeles

Backend Team Lead (PHP/Laravel)


Location: Brazil


Our trusted high-growth healthcare technology partner is seeking a talented Backend Team Lead (PHP/Laravel) to join their dynamic team. This innovative company is dedicated to revolutionizing the healthcare industry through cutting-edge technology solutions.


Position Overview


As a Backend Team Lead , you will play a key role in leading the backend development team while contributing to the development and implementation of scalable and robust software solutions that support the company's mission and goals. You will guide and support the backend team while working closely with cross-functional teams to design, build, and maintain innovative applications and platforms that drive business success and improve patient outcomes.


Primary Responsibilities


  • Team Leadership:

Lead and support the backend engineering team, ensuring effective collaboration, task distribution, and delivery of high-quality software.

  • Platform Development:

Spearhead the development and optimization of our EHR platform using PHP/Laravel , ensuring high performance, reliability, and scalability.

  • Database Development:

Creating database schemas that represent and support business processes.

  • API Development and Integration:

Develop and maintain APIs for internal and external use, facilitating seamless integration with other healthcare systems and third-party services.

  • Security Compliance:

Ensure the platform's compliance with healthcare industry standards, including HIPAA , by implementing and maintaining robust security measures and data protection protocols.


Additional Responsibilities


  • Mentor backend developers, providing guidance on best practices in backend development, code review, and team collaboration.
  • Support the team in resolving technical challenges and ensure consistent development standards across the team.
  • Stay abreast of new technology trends and evaluate their application to continually innovate and enhance the platform.
  • Participate in the agile development process, contributing to sprint planning, stand-ups, and retrospectives, ensuring timely delivery of high-quality software.
  • Collaborate with the design team to refine the platform's user interface and experience, implementing responsive and intuitive front-end functionalities using modern JavaScript frameworks.


Competencies / Requirements


  • Technical Expertise:

Strong proficiency in PHP/Laravel and MySQL . Familiarity with version control tools, preferably Git .

  • Experience:

At least 6+ years of experience in backend development , with a proven track record of developing and maintaining scalable web applications. Previous experience leading or mentoring developers is required. Experience in the healthcare sector or EHR platforms is highly desirable.

  • Problem-Solving Skills:

We are seeking an experienced Visual & Brand Experience Designer to support a large-scale digital product initiative focused on modernizing the user experience of a leading marketplace platform. You will lead the Visual Makeover & Usability workstream while also helping shape a multi-brand gallery experience that brings together multiple brands within a single marketplace environment. The ideal candidate is a highly creative product designer who can quickly move from research and benchmarking into compelling visual concepts that inspire stakeholders and guide product direction.

What You’ll Do

  • Design and lead the visual direction for key product workstreams focused on improving usability and modernizing the marketplace interface.
  • Conduct benchmarking of leading global marketplace platforms to inform design strategy and identify best-in-class user experience patterns.

  • Design and prototype a multi-brand navigation and discovery experience that enables users to seamlessly browse across brands within a unified marketplace.

  • Work within a fast-moving consulting team delivering iterative design outputs across short delivery cycles.


Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in product design, visual design, or UI design

  • Deep understanding of e-commerce and marketplace design patterns
  • Experience analyzing and benchmarking international digital products
  • Ability to produce high-fidelity concepts and exploratory prototypes that communicate bold design ideas
  • Comfort presenting conceptual work to senior leadership and stakeholders
  • Fluency in Portuguese (required working language)
  • Ability to thrive in fast-paced consulting environments with rapid iteration cycles


Preferred Qualifications

  • Previous experience in agency or consulting environments with fast delivery timelines


If you’re a designer who enjoys pushing visual boundaries, exploring global product patterns, and shaping the experience of large-scale digital platforms, this role offers the opportunity to make a meaningful impact on a high-visibility product initiative.

Raza Engage ( is a leading global A2P messaging enterprise and aggregator , providing enterprise-grade SMS solutions for businesses around the world. We specialize in helping companies scale secure, high-quality messaging services to reach customers efficiently, reliably, and at scale.

title: Senior Executive Assistant | Senior Virtual Assistant
description:

Salary: 3,700 BRL/ month


Saleslights is looking for a bright, enthusiastic, vibrant, and highly organized Senior Executive Assistant / Virtual Assistant to work directly with ambitious founders and senior sales leaders in the United States.

The ideal candidate is already active on , enjoys building their own professional brand, and is interested in sales, marketing, technology, and social selling .


You may already be posting insights, engaging with business content, or participating in conversations around:

• B2B sales

• marketing strategy

• technology

• entrepreneurship


A background in sales and marketing is highly valued for this role.


Additionally, the ideal candidate is a passionate and skilled video editor who enjoys producing their own short-form social media videos and understands the dynamics of modern vertical video content.

This role is ideal for someone who enjoys working closely with driven founders and elite sales professionals and thrives in a professional, fast-moving environment.


Overview:

Saleslights works with ambitious founders in the United States to help them build visibility, credibility, and authority through strategic communication and founder-led content.


Our clients are typically:

• cybersecurity founders

• B2B SaaS founders

• high-growth service company CEOs


They are visionary operators who move quickly and think strategically.

They do not need task managers.

They need someone who can manage communication, momentum, and execution around them.

Your role is to become the trusted operational partner for a small group of founders and senior / elite salespeople.


Your Mission:

You will manage up to three US founders or senior sales professionals and ensure they consistently complete a small number of high-impact activities each month.


Your job is to:

• organize communication

• keep projects moving

• motivate founder or sales leader participation

• maintain professional correspondence

• ensure key deliverables are completed


This role is closer to a Chief-of-Staff / Executive Assistant hybrid than a typical VA role.


Core Responsibilities:

You will manage the following for each founder or senior sales professional.


Founder Communication

Primary communication channel via email.


You will:

• write thoughtful, professional emails

• summarize discussions clearly

• guide founders or sales leaders toward next steps

• keep communication structured and calm

Expect to write long-form strategic emails , not quick chat replies.


Founder Momentum


Each month you will ensure founders or senior sales professionals complete:

• 2 short video recordings

• 5 document approvals

• up to 4 meetings


Your role is to:

• schedule

• follow up

• motivate

• remove friction

This requires strong soft leadership and persuasion skills .


Project Organization


You will maintain simple project tracking for each founder or sales leader.


Responsibilities include:

• organizing deliverables

• tracking approvals

• maintaining timelines

• ensuring no work stalls

You will operate similarly to a lightweight project manager .


Relationship Management


You will be the primary point of coordination between:

• the founder or sales leader

• the Saleslights internal team


You must maintain:

• professionalism

• calm communication

• clarity under pressure


What This Role Is Not

This is not a typical VA task role .

It is not:

• data entry

• admin errands

• simple task execution


This role requires someone comfortable working with driven founders, executives, and senior sales professionals from the US and Europe .

You must be comfortable with:

• fast-moving conversations

• high expectations

• strategic discussions


Ideal Candidate Profile

We are looking for someone who has previously worked as:

• Executive Assistant to a CEO

• Chief of Staff style operator

• Agency Account Manager

• Founder or sales leader support operator


Key traits:

• extremely organized

• confident communicator

• calm under pressure

• professional writing ability

• proactive and responsible

You should enjoy working with high-performance personalities .


Work Structure

Each operator manages up to three founders or senior sales professionals .

Typical monthly workload per client:

• 2 videos coordinated

• 5 approvals managed

• 4 meetings maximum

This is a relationship and communication management role , not heavy operational labor.


Compensation


Salary: 3,700 BRL / month

Full-time role.

Because this is a high-trust position supporting founders and senior sales professionals directly:

outside client work is not permitted.


Why This Role Is Unique

You will work directly with founders and senior sales professionals building companies in:

• cybersecurity

• B2B technology

• high-growth services


You will gain exposure to:

• strategy discussions

• founder decision making

  • international business operations
