  • Technical background in:
  • Data architecture concepts
  • APIs & system integrations
  • Cloud environments (Azure, AWS or GCP)
  • Data modelling methodologies (BEAM, Kimbal, etc.)
  • Experience working in AI-related initiatives (ML models, automation, data pipelines, or analytics projects).
  • Experience writing detailed technical user stories for engineering teams.
  • Hands-on experience working with Agile/Scrum methodology.
  • Experience leading Scrum ceremonies.
  • Previous experience as a Project Manager would be beneficial but is not required. The core skills we are looking for are related to a Business Analyst with a focus on Data.
  • Strong stakeholder management skills.
  • Excellent written and verbal English (mandatory).
  • Availability to work overlapping with Australia (preferably 13:00–22:00 BRT).



Our Values

We’re proud to share the values we live by. They’re not dusty abstract concepts. Our values define our culture: they act as a promise to our customers and a constant challenge to ourselves, both as individuals and as a team, to be Game-Changers.

#1 Be the best you can be

We challenge ourselves to raise our game each day. By embracing a mindset of growth, we continuously strive to improve ourselves, our ways of working, and the service we deliver to our customers.


#2 We do what we say.

When we make a promise, we follow-through - no excuses. We don’t leave anyone hanging or walk away from challenges. Reliable and focused, we value clear communication to build trust and give customers, and colleagues, the confidence they can count on us every time.


#3 Together we win.

Business is the biggest team sport of them all. By communicating well, breaking down silos and staying aligned, we create clarity and focus. Strong relationships, shared goals and commitment make us a winning team – for each other and for our customers.


Equal Opportunities at Acora

Acora is an equal opportunity employer, committed to providing equal opportunities regardless of race or ethnic origin, gender identity, family situation, sexual orientation, disability, religion or age. We hire our people on the basis of qualifications, merit, skills, and business need.


Acora is a Level 1 Disability Confident Committed Employer and will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, perform essential job functions, and receive equitable benefits and all privileges of employment. Please contact us to request any reasonable adjustments.


Join us at Acora in creating a workplace where everyone can succeed and make an impact. We look forward to welcoming you to our team!

  • Ei #fera, chegou o momento de encarar um novo desafio em sua carreira! Venha ser um #ferabrq


- O que procuramos?


Buscamos um #fera com espírito empreendedor e que sabe que é o verdadeiro protagonista do seu sucesso! Queremos em nosso time pessoas motivadas por desafios, constante evolução e, claro, que são apaixonadas por tecnologia e transformação!


- O que você deve ter?


  • Inglês avançado/fluente para atuação com time Global.
  • Experiência com Experience Cloud .
  • Ter experiência em desenvolvimento e customização na plataforma Salesforce (Salesforce CRM, Lightning, Apex, Visualforce, Aura e LWC), seguindo boas práticas de governança e arquitetura.
  • Atuar em todo o ciclo de desenvolvimento (análise, implementação, testes, implantação, suporte e manutenção) da instância Salesforce.
  • Realizar codificação e integrações utilizando Apex, SOQL, SOSL e APIs REST, bem como ferramentas como Data Loader, Postman e recursos OOB (out of the box) do Salesforce.
  • Possuir conhecimento sólido em tecnologias web (JavaScript, HTML5 e CSS).
  • Utilizar controle de versionamento (Git/Bitbucket).
  • Colaborar com usuários-chave, arquitetos e consultores de negócio, realizando demonstrações e garantindo aderência aos requisitos funcionais e de experiência do usuário.
  • Elaborar documentação técnica, protótipos, fluxogramas, diagramas de sequência e planos de testes, assegurando qualidade e conformidade das entregas.
  • Realizar revisão de código e aplicar padrões consolidados de desenvolvimento (OOP, MVC/MVCS, Domain Layer Principle).


Diferenciais:


  • Espanhol avançado/fluente.
  • Ter experiência com Salesforce Commerce Cloud.
  • Possuir certificações Salesforce, como: Platform Developer I, Platform App Builder, Platform Developer II, Administrator, JavaScript Developer I, Data Architect, Sharing and Visibility Architect

Mais do que um plano de carreira !


A BRQ acredita que cada fera deve ser protagonista do seu crescimento, tendo autonomia para criar seu próprio plano de desenvolvimento profissional. Nosso plano de carreira é dividido em 4 pilares:


Carreira técnica: Você pode seguir a trilha de crescimento técnico, se o seu objetivo for se desenvolver cada vez mais em diferentes tecnologias. Oferecemos diversos treinamentos!


Carreira de Liderança: Você pode seguir a trilha e se tornar um líder, desenvolver pessoas, auxiliar na evolução profissional e pessoal e estimular o crescimento para o surgimento de novos talentos.


Experiência internacional: Estamos crescendo cada vez mais fora do Brasil e você tem possibilidade de atuar em projetos para outros países, ou diretamente nos países onde a BRQ tem sede.

Plano de Saúde; Plano Odontológico; Seguro de Vida; Vale Refeição; Vale Alimentação; Horário Flexível; Gympass, Telemedicina, Telenutrição, Canal de suporte emocional 24h e muito mais!

Temos um clima descontraído, diversos programas e eventos internos. Adoramos comemorar! E fazemos isso muito bem! Veja aqui no Youtube: youtube.com/brqdigitalsolutions


Curtiu? Então inscreva-se e venha para o melhor da Transformação Digital com a gente!

title: Analista de P&D Senior - Pack
description:
Convidamos você a ser parte de uma equipe comprometida em desenvolver marcas que entregam o melhor cuidado que as pessoas necessitam no seu dia a dia e em cada fase de suas vidas.


A Softys é uma multinacional chilena, líder na América Latina, no desenvolvimento de produtos e soluções para o cuidado das pessoas com suas diferentes marcas de higiene pessoal e limpeza.


Presente em 15 mercados latino-americanos, possui 28 fábricas de tissue e higiene pessoal em 8 países como Brasil, Argentina, Chile, Colômbia, Equador, México, Peru e Uruguai.


Somos uma empresa preocupada com as necessidades das pessoas. Através das nossas marcas e produtos cuidamos das pessoas e de suas necessidades diárias, proporcionando segurança, tranquilidade, autonomia e liberdade que necessitam em cada etapa de suas vidas com marcas icónicas e queridas como, BigFral®, Pom Pom®, Cremer Infantil®, Turma da Mônica Baby®, Elite® , Higienol®, Confort®, Nova®, Sussex®, Babysec®, Cotidian®, Ladysoft® e Elite Professional®.


Estamos próximo às pessoas em todos os momentos para que ninguém se sinta sozinho no cuidado de suas necessidades, impactando positivamente na qualidade de vida.


Na Softys estamos comprometidos com a inovação na qualidade, inovando em processos e estratégias, priorizando a melhoria contínua no aspecto tecnológico, pessoal e necessidades dos consumidores.


Temos um compromisso real com a sustentabilidade, cuidando que todas as nossas ações se enquadrem dentro do marco de respeito no entorno social, das comunidades e do meio ambiente.



SEU DESAFIO: Dar suporte técnico/participar dos projetos de desenvolvimento, de melhoria contínua e de redução de custo abrangendo produto, insumos, fornecedores, visando atender os planos de inovação e estratégicos da Cia.


Principais Responsabilidades e Atribuições:

  • Participar dos testes de produto e matérias-primas nas máquinas referentes aos projetos de desenvolvimento, melhoria, redução de custo, fornecedor alternativo durante desenvolvimento, lote piloto, homologação e start-up da produção.
  • Realizar testes de laboratório no produto acabado, matéria-prima e material de embalagem relacionados com projetos de desenvolvimento, melhoria contínua, redução de custo e análise da concorrência por meio da realização das metodologias de análises vigentes garantindo conformidade dos resultados.
  • Dar suporte na preparação, revisão e atualização das especificações técnica de produto acabado, matéria-prima, estrutura de consumo e custo de produto.
  • Solicitar, acompanhar e alterar cadastro de produto acabado, material de embalagem, materiais não produtivos e listas técnicas no SAP através das planilhas de solicitação de cadastro vigente.
  • Dar suporte na elaboração, revisão e atualização das metodologias de análise de produto acabado e matéria-prima.
  • Preparar e testar protótipos de produto acabado, matéria-prima e material de embalagem de acordo com a especificação definida visando similaridade com o produto acabado final.
  • Dar suporte técnico nos estudos para suportar claims de produto.


Requisitos:

  • Capacidade analítica e de síntese
  • Dinâmico, flexível, trabalho em equipe
  • Bom relacionamento interpessoal
  • Ter senso de responsabilidade
  • Ter senso de pertencimento e engajamento
  • Inglês e Espanhol Intermediário
  • Pacote Office e desejável sistema integrado SAP
  • Conhecimento técnico e experiência no segmento de tissue - desenvolvimento de produto, desenvolvimento de embalagem, qualidade e processo


Benefícios

  • Vale Alimentação
  • Seguro de Vida
  • Plano de Médico, extensível aos seus dependentes
  • Plano Odontológico - Bradesco, extensível aos dependentes
  • Convênio Farmácia
  • PLR
  • Total Pass - Convênio com rede de academias

title: Kofax Developer (French Speaker) - Relocation to Portugal
description:
Your connection with Aubay starts in the following lines:

Aubay Portugal is a French multinational company that has been operating in the country since 2007, with offices in Lisbon and Porto. We are a leading technology consultancy with a presence in seven European Union countries, specializing in the management, implementation, development and maintenance of information systems.

With more than 150 active partners, we operate in strategic sectors such as banking, insurance, automotive, aviation, telecommunications, services and energy, driving innovation and digital transformation.

Excellence, proximity and innovation are the pillars that distinguish us and enable us to support companies in building technological solutions that make a difference.


What are we looking for?

  • 3+ years with Kofax;
  • Experience with Kofax TotalAgility (KTA) and Kofax Insight (certified if possible);
  • English: B2 (spoken and written);
  • French: B2 (spoken and written);
  • Willing to relocate to Portugal.


What do we have to offer you?

  • Comprehensive health insurance, including dental coverage;
  • Feedback&Coffee – our integrated performance management system, with regular feedback sessions and a structured Career Progression Model;
  • Aubay Training Academy, designed for your development: technical and behavioural training (in-class and e-learning), Meet&Techs, Webinars, Mentoring and Technology Centers;
  • Events and team building activities that strengthen team spirit and promote closeness;

  • Health and well-being programme, with workshops and initiatives for our employees and other activities open to the community;
  • We grow with you and your family - we offer a Mini-Aubilous Kit when your children are born and annual support for school supplies, from pre-school to higher education;
  • Language platform, with conversation classes in 12 languages;
  • Working model: hybrid in Lisbon after the work visa is completed.


What makes us different?

  • Our organisational culture is based on solid values: commitment, excellence, team spirit, well-being, happiness and empathy;
  • We value and recognise those who are part of our history, with referral awards and a special birthday gift;

Your next adventure starts here!

title: Editorial Graphic Designer (Interiors + Spaces)
description:
So… who the heck is Residence Supply?


I'm Jacky, the founder. We started as a local lighting brand obsessed with historical architecture and heirloom craftsmanship. In just a few years we blew past 8 figures, launched hundreds of handcrafted SKUs, and built a cult following of design-obsessed homeowners. Our fixtures live in Architectural Digest–worthy homes.


Now we're building the ULTIMATE creative team. One that takes us from \"fastest-growing DTC brand\" to category-defining design house. We need a graphic designer who doesn't just execute... but one who sees the world the way our customers do. Through the lens of beauty, heritage, and taste.


What You'll Do

  • Design editorial ads that feel like they were pulled from a print magazine
  • Translate interior design trends and RS products into visual stories that stop the scroll
  • Build mood boards and visual direction decks to guide campaigns
  • Maintain and elevate brand visual consistency across every creative touchpoint
  • Collaborate with our Creative Strategist, Content team, and Founder on campaign ideation
  • QC all outgoing creative. Nothing ships unless it looks like Residence Supply


Who You Are

  • 3+ years designing for high-end lifestyle, interiors, fashion, or luxury DTC brands
  • Your portfolio looks like a coffee table book, not a social media dump
  • Obsessed with typography, white space, negative space, and editorial composition
  • You follow interior designers, architects, and design publications
  • Proficient in Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign)
  • You understand the difference between beautiful and effective
  • Architecture or interior design background? You're already shortlisted.


What We're Building

Residence Supply is not trying to be another ecommerce brand. We're becoming a heritage-driven design house growing 100% year over year. This role will define the visual language that new customers judge us by. Your work will live in catalogs, on Pinterest boards of people building their dream homes, and in the feeds of the most design-literate buyers in the country.


This is your chance to join a founding creative team before the rocket takes off.


What We're Offering

  • Competitive Salary
  • 10 days PTO per year
  • Opportunity to grow into creative strategist/lead graphic designer
  • Fully remote


How to Apply

Don't send us a generic application. Send us:

  • A portfolio or 3–5 pieces you're most proud of... especially anything editorial, catalog, or interiors-adjacent please!
  • A quick paragraph on how you'd approach the visual feel of a Residence Supply print catalog
  • Tell us: what brand's visual identity do you wish you had built and why?


If the interview goes well, we hire on the call. Good luck.

title: Project Manager
description:
Join Aditi Consulting as a Project Manager!


Summary:

We are seeking a Project Manager to support a global M&A divestiture initiative involving the disposition of 150+ applications across multiple regions, including significant collaboration with teams in Japan . This role requires ERP experience (SAP, Epicor, ETQ, Reliance, or similar), strong technical communication skills, and the ability to manage tight timelines driven by Transition Service Agreements (TSAs) .

Responsibilities:

  • Lead global application disposition efforts across multiple waves of work.
  • Manage timelines tied to TSA deadlines to avoid costly extensions.
  • Coordinate closely with technical teams on integrations, workflows, and decommissioning plans.
  • Work with sourcing, suppliers, purchasing, and invoicing teams to ensure vendor alignment.
  • Facilitate meetings with global stakeholders, including late-night sessions with Japan-based teams (flex schedule provided).
  • Drive project planning, risk management, documentation, and status reporting.
  • Ensure smooth communication and alignment across business, IT, and regional teams.

Required Qualifications:

  • Proven Project Management experience in M&A divestiture environments.
  • Familiarity with Transition Service Agreements (TSAs) .
  • Experience with at least one ERP or enterprise platform (SAP, Epicor, ETQ, Reliance, etc.).
  • Strong understanding of sourcing, suppliers, purchasing, and invoicing processes.
  • Excellent English communication skills , including the ability to follow technical integration discussions.
  • Experience working with global or cross-cultural teams.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Project Management certification (PMP, Prince2, Agile/Scrum).
  • Experience collaborating with Japan or APAC teams.
  • Background in application disposition, decommissioning, or IT transformation.
  • Knowledge of integration workflows and system dependencies.

Soft Skills:

  • Strong stakeholder management and communication abilities.
  • Ability to navigate ambiguity and drive clarity in complex technical environments.
  • Proactive risk identification and problem-solving.
  • High level of organization and multitasking in fast-paced settings.
  • Flexibility and adaptability when working across global time zones.

title: Coordenador (a) Tecnico
description:
Prazer, somos a Claro!


Aqui, temos um grande time que faz tudo acontecer! É com o esforço e a dedicação de cada uma de nossas Pessoas que somos hoje referência no que fazemos, atuando unidos no nosso propósito, que é “Conectar para uma vida mais divertida e produtiva”.


Somamos todas as tecnologias para criar a melhor e mais completa infraestrutura de conectividade do País. Somos multicampeões confirmado pelo Speedtest como Internet móvel mais rápida e estável e com rede wi-fi mais estável do Brasil, entre tantos outros reconhecimentos. Também somos a 5º marca mais valiosa do Brasil (BrandZ).


Estamos presentes em mais de 4.800 municípios, somando mais de 83 milhões de clientes. Lideramos o saldo de portabilidade há mais de 5 anos.


E tem mais: inovamos nossos produtos e serviços para atender cada vez melhor nossos usuários! Por isso, hoje, contamos com soluções de entretenimento (Claro música, Claro tv+, Claro livros, Claro vídeo e Claro gaming), finanças (Claro pay) e muito mais! Temos presença aeroespacial (com 5 satélites em órbita pela Embratel) e somos referência em conectividade industrial, automotiva, agronegócio e outros. Também temos um ambiente de conexão entre nossos negócios e o ecossistema de inovação, que é o beOn , o hub de inovação da Claro e Embratel.

Sustentabilidade é um valor para a Claro. Investimos no desenvolvimento ambiental, economico e social, prezando sempre pela governança, responsabilidade ambiental, proteção de dados e impacto social. Por meio do Instituto Claro , conectamos pessoas para um futuro melhor, aliando os serviços prestados a investimentos sociais em projetos de educação e cidadania.


E aí, deu match? Vem pra Claro construir o novo com a gente!


Como será o seu dia a dia?


  • Selecionar, liderar, orientar, treinar, desenvolver e motivar a equipe técnica buscando comprometimento de todos com os resultados da área,
  • Controle de qualidade das atividades de manutenção e implantação executadas pelas contratadas,
  • Planejar e programar as estratégias da área visando o atingimento das metas e indicadores da empresa,
  • Buscar novas soluções tecnológicas, visando a melhoria da produtividade e qualidade das demandas,
  • Gerenciar a conservação de todo patrimonio, utilizado pelo corpo técnico, veículos medidores, materiais e etc, através de controle, construção de planilhas e vistorias continuas



O que esperamos de você?

  • Pensa e age a partir das perspectivas dos clientes. Demonstra interesse e curiosidade de conhecer os clientes, seus comportamentos e preferências para atender e superar suas expectativas;
  • Demonstra compromisso permanente em aprender, ensinar e desenvolver, contribuindo para um ambiente descontraído, respeitoso e colaborativo, incentivando a diversidade;
  • É flexível para se desprender de paradigmas e modelos mentais existentes. Busca soluções inovadoras e sustentáveis, para criar vantagens competitivas para o negócio, equilibrando os interesses econômicos, ambientais e sociais.


Para fazer parte do nosso time, é essencial:

  • Graduação em Engenharia, Telecom e/ou áreas correlatas;
  • Experiência comprovada com gestão de pessoas, ter conhecimento de construção, operação e manutenção de redes fibra ótica, Gpon coaxiais , saber e aplicar as normas de segurança do trabalho para a área



E por que a escolher a Claro?

Na Claro, pessoas é um dos nossos valores. Com este pensamento, investimos sempre no cuidado com a saúde, bem-estar e qualidade de vida dos nossos colaboradores!

Para que você tenha a melhor experiência em sua jornada com a gente, oferecemos um atraente pacote de benefícios. Veja só:

Assistência Médica

Assistência Odontológica

Auxílio para patologias graves

· Benefício Farmácia

· Programa de Apoio Pessoal

· Claro Running

· Vale-Refeição e Alimentação

· Vale-Transporte

· Auxílio Creche/Babá

· Auxílio ao Dependente com Deficiência

· Previdência Privada

· Seguro de Vida

Seguro saúde - Pets

Wellhub

· Combo Colaborador

· Programa de Reconhecimento por tempo de casa

· Jornada Flexível

· Convênios e Parcerias

· E muito mais!

Na nossa empresa, valorizamos um ambiente inclusivo, diverso, ético, colaborativo e harmônico. Não fazemos distinção de gênero, raça, cor, orientação sexual, posição social ou deficiências. Todos e todas são bem-vindos(as)!

title: Analista de Planejamento de Obras
description:
Quem é a Urbem ?

Unindo tecnologia e industrialização a uma matéria-prima renovável, trazemos para o Brasil a madeira engenheirada, alternativa construtiva que contribui para solucionar as dores da construção civil. Estamos falando de um canteiro de obras mais produtivo, previsível, sem geração de resíduos, mais rápido e seguro. Já pensou?


Somos a face de uma nova relação entre empresas, meio ambiente e pessoas. Com projetos íntegros, que nascem no campo e constroem nossas cidades.


Valorizamos a diversidade e promovemos a inclusão a partir de compromissos que impulsionam o desenvolvimento humano sustentável, a criatividade e a inovação.


Nosso ambiente é diverso, onde pessoas de todos os gêneros, raça, idade, orientação sexual e com deficiência escolhem para se desenvolver como pessoa e profissional.


O que esperamos de você?

Estamos em busca de pessoas para serem protagonistas de uma nova dinâmica que

conecta florestas a cidades. Que queiram se desenvolver e aprender constantemente, compartilhando, colaborando, inovando e entregando valor para todos os nossos clientes.


Temos certeza que uma de nossas oportunidades vai dar um “match” com você!


Confira abaixo as as atividades que estão sob a responsabilidade da posição de Analista de Planejamento de Obras :

  • Elaborar e manter atualizados os cronogramas físico-financeiros das obras, definindo etapas, prazos e sequenciamento das atividades.
  • Planejar e acompanhar a execução das atividades de obra, verificando o progresso em relação ao planejamento.
  • Controlar o avanço físico da obra, comparando o realizado com o planejado e identificando desvios.
  • Elaborar e atualizar relatórios de acompanhamento de obras, apresentando indicadores de prazo, custos e produtividade.
  • Apoiar na definição de planos de ação para correção de atrasos ou desvios de execução.
  • Realizar medições de serviços executados e apoiar o controle de contratos com fornecedores e prestadores de serviço.
  • Integrar informações entre as áreas de engenharia, suprimentos, produção, financeiro e execução da obra.
  • Apoiar o planejamento de recursos necessários para a obra, como materiais, equipamentos e mão de obra.
  • Monitorar riscos relacionados à execução da obra e propor medidas de mitigação.


O que você precisa ter?

  • Ensino superior completo ou em andamento em Engenharia Civil, Engenharia de Produção, Arquitetura ou áreas correlatas.
  • Domínio Excel como ferramentas de planejamento e controle de gestão de obras.
  • Vivência no ramo de construção civil.
  • Experiência com planejamento e controle de obras.
  • Conhecimento em cronograma físico-financeiro e leitura de projetos.
  • Organização, planejamento e senso de prioridade.
  • Disposição para aprender e encarar desafios.


E aí, vamos construir as cidades do futuro, juntos?

Vem ser URBEM .

title: Senior Biostatistician
description:
Now Hiring | Senior Biostatistician Consultant

Remote

Rate: $1 – $40 USD/hour


We are seeking an experienced Senior Biostatistician Consultant to provide statistical expertise for clinical research and support the design, analysis, and reporting of clinical trials. This role involves collaborating with cross-functional teams to ensure high-quality statistical analysis and regulatory-compliant data reporting.


Requirements

  • Master’s degree in Statistics or related field (PhD strongly preferred).
  • 5+ years of experience supporting clinical trials in pharmaceutical or biotechnology industries.
  • Experience working with CROs is strongly preferred.
  • Strong experience in protocol development, SAP creation, and clinical study reporting .
  • Solid SAS programming skills for QC of tables, listings, and figures (TLFs).
  • Knowledge of R programming is a plus.
  • Experience implementing CDISC standards and working with ADaM datasets .
  • Strong communication skills with the ability to explain statistical concepts clearly.

Nice to Have

  • Experience in oncology clinical trials .
  • Ability to collaborate with global and cross-functional teams .


This is an excellent opportunity for experienced biostatisticians who want to contribute to high-impact clinical research projects in a global, remote environment .

title: PLM Architect
description:
About us :

ITC Infotech is a leading global technology services and solutions provider, led by Business and Technology Consulting. ITC Infotech provides business-friendly solutions to help clients succeed and be future-ready, by seamlessly bringing together digital expertise, strong industry speciﬁc alliances and the unique ability to leverage deep domain expertise from ITC Group businesses. We provide technology solutions and services to enterprises across industries such as Banking & Financial Services, Healthcare, Manufacturing, Consumer Goods, Travel and Hospitality, through a combination of traditional and newer business models, as a long-term sustainable partner.

Responsibilities

  • You will lead and/or support consulting services and implementation projects for Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) using PTC Windchill Product suite.

  • You will execute assigned project tasks for planning, analysis, development, and testing.
  • You will execute technical tasks including the installation and configuration of PLM software, assessing gaps between requirements and software functionality and define appropriate path forward debugging, data migration, infrastructure, and deployment support.
  • You will ensure quality through established software engineering methods and processes.
  • You will be a valued project team contributor by demonstrating an ability to balance independent work practices with appropriate levels of communication across a broad spectrum of project stakeholders.
  • You will manage commitments within a flexible work schedule.

Knowledge and Abilities:

  • Strong PLM domain knowledge
  • Proven experience on delivering PLM solutions to customers
  • Strong interpersonal skills
  • Strong communication and presentation skills
  • Knowledge of PTC Windchill Product suites desired.
  • Be able to work autonomously and focus on goals.
  • Be customer service oriented.
  • Have programming skills, preferably in Java.
  • A desire to continue your professional growth through formal and on-the-job ongoing product and consulting skills training.

Must Have Skills

  • 5-10+ years’ experience in PLM, preferably PTC Windchill Product suite.
  • Participated in PLM Implementation projects.
  • Educational background in Engineering or Computer Science (bachelor’s or master’s Degree Level)
  • Languages: Advanced or Fluent Proficiency level (written and spoken) in English and Spanish.
  • Willingness to travel, as needed

title: SAP Specialist
description:
SAP S/4HANA FICO AMS Consultant

Location: Brazil (Remote)

Duration: Long Term


Key Responsibilities

  • Provide L2/L3 production support for SAP S/4HANA Finance (FICO) modules.
  • Manage incidents, service requests, and problem tickets using ITSM tools such as ServiceNow.
  • Perform root cause analysis (RCA) and implement permanent solutions for recurring system issues.
  • Support month-end, quarter-end, and year-end financial closing activities with finance teams.
  • Handle critical finance incidents and communicate updates to business and IT stakeholders.
  • Support and troubleshoot SAP FI modules including:
  • General Ledger (FI-GL)
  • Accounts Payable (FI-AP)
  • Accounts Receivable (FI-AR)
  • Asset Accounting (FI-AA)
  • Bank Accounting and Electronic Bank Statements
  • Provide support for Controlling (CO) processes during closing cycles including:
  • Material Ledger
  • Cost Center Accounting
  • Profit Center Accounting
  • Allocations and settlements
  • Analyze integration issues between finance and logistics processes such as FI-MM and FI-SD integrations.
  • Deliver minor system enhancements and configuration updates within the AMS support scope.
  • Prepare functional documentation, test cases, and support user acceptance testing (UAT).
  • Participate in change management and release processes.
  • Maintain high-quality documentation aligned with audit and compliance standards.


Required Skills & Experience

  • 7–10 years of experience in SAP FICO consulting or application support.
  • Strong hands-on experience with SAP S/4HANA Finance modules.
  • Proven experience in Application Management Support (AMS) or production support environments.
  • Solid knowledge of FI modules including GL, AP, AR, Asset Accounting, and Bank Accounting.
  • Working knowledge of SAP CO processes, especially Material Ledger and month-end close activities.
  • Experience handling incident management, problem management, and service requests.
  • Familiarity with ITSM platforms such as ServiceNow.
  • Understanding of Brazil localization, taxes, and statutory financial requirements is highly desirable.
  • Strong analytical, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Information Systems, or related field.
  • SAP S/4HANA Finance certification is a plus.

title: Senior SRE Engineer (Temporary Contract)
description:
About You

This is a high‑impact, high‑expectation senior DevOps/SRE role supporting a Private Equity Group (PEG) platform. The team is new, the infrastructure is new, and the customer is extremely selective and private.


You must operate with strong autonomy , influence engineering decisions, challenge assumptions, and serve as a thought partner rather than an order‑taker. You will work directly with VP‑level stakeholders in a technical environment where reliability, deployment safety, and clarity in communication are essential.


This position requires someone who can own DevOps architecture end‑to‑end , enable safe and frequent deployments, and establish operational excellence from day zero.


Note: This position is offered under a contractor model for a period of 6 months .


You Bring to Applaudo the Following Competencies

  • Proven ownership of production-grade CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions reusable workflows and GitOps automation with ArgoCD .
  • Expert-level Kubernetes and EKS operations , including node group management, Karpenter autoscaling, RBAC, PDBs, and topology constraints.
  • Production-scale Terraform expertise , including module design, S3 + DynamoDB remote state , and PR-driven workflows via Atlantis .
  • Strong reliability engineering experience , including SLO/SLI design, alerting strategies, dashboards, incident response, and post-incident reviews.
  • Hands-on experience operating HashiCorp Vault , including auth backends, PKI, dynamic secrets, and audit logging.
  • Experience implementing supply-chain security controls , including image scanning and signing, SBOM generation, and policy enforcement with OPA/Gatekeeper.
  • Strong experience with observability stacks , including Prometheus, Grafana, Loki, Tempo, and Alertmanager.
  • Experience with service mesh technologies such as Istio , including traffic management, mTLS, AuthorizationPolicies, and circuit breaking.
  • Scripting ability using Python and Bash for automation and operational tooling.
  • Active use of AI-assisted engineering tools such as Cursor, GitHub Copilot, or Cloud Code to accelerate IaC development, incident response, and runbook generation.
  • Strong communication skills, with the ability to communicate clearly and confidently with VP-level stakeholders during operational incidents.
  • Advanced English proficiency, as you will work directly with US-based clients.


You Will Be Accountable for the Following Responsibilities

  • Design and maintain GitHub Actions reusable workflows across a multi-repository ecosystem.
  • Own GitOps deployments through ArgoCD , including promotion workflows, sync policies, drift detection, and automated rollback strategies.
  • Implement deployment safety mechanisms such as environment protections, concurrency rules, and verification gates .
  • Operate and upgrade EKS clusters , including Karpenter provisioning, node groups, and critical cluster add-ons.
  • Maintain Terraform-driven infrastructure and enforce PR-driven workflows through Atlantis.
  • Define and maintain SLOs, SLIs, alerting rules, and monitoring dashboards across platform services.
  • Lead incident response , coordinate recovery efforts, and execute structured post-incident reviews.
  • Participate in an on-call rotation and contribute to improving operational processes.
  • Operate and maintain HashiCorp Vault , including policies, authentication backends, and secret engines.
  • Implement supply-chain security controls , including Trivy scanning, Cosign signing, SBOM generation, and OPA/Gatekeeper enforcement.
  • Partner with Security Engineering on network policies, egress controls, and compliance standards .
  • Automate repetitive tasks and maintain proactive runbooks to reduce operational risk.
  • Use AI tools to improve infrastructure automation, documentation, and deployment safety validation.
  • Collaborate with product teams to strengthen SLOs and deployment safety practices .
  • Challenge technical assumptions and advocate for scalable, secure DevOps architectures .


Qualifications

  • Proven end-to-end ownership of production-grade Kubernetes/EKS environments including Karpenter and Atlantis-driven Terraform workflows.
  • Demonstrated expertise with ArgoCD GitOps patterns.
  • Hands-on experience with HashiCorp Vault, supply-chain security controls, and structured incident response including on-call rotations and post-incident reviews.
  • Active use of AI-assisted tools such as Cursor, GitHub Copilot, or Cloud Code as part of daily engineering workflow.


Additional Information

About Us


We Are Engineered Different.


At Applaudo, talented people design, build, and scale meaningful, AI-powered solutions that create real business impact. As an AI-native organization, we collaborate across design, development, cloud, data, and artificial intelligence to turn ideas into scalable products that transform how companies operate, make decisions, and grow.


We are building a high-performance culture grounded in five values: Empowering Excellence, Collaborative Teamwork, Unsolicited Respect, Consistent Transparency, and Efficient Communication . These define how we work, how we support one another, and how we hold ourselves accountable.


Applaudo is a place for people who want to learn fast, take ownership, and work alongside strong teams they are proud to belong to. Joining us means being part of an organization that is evolving intentionally, investing in modern ways of working, and leading AI-native transformation at scale.

title: Technical Support Engineer
description:
We are still looking for talent… and we would love for you to join our team!

For over 25 years, UST has worked alongside the world’s best companies to make a real impact through business transformation. Driven by technology, inspired by people, and guided by our purpose, UST supports clients from design to implementation. Together, with more than 30,000 employees in 30 countries, we build to create limitless impact, reaching billions of lives in the process.

We are looking for an experienced L2 Support Analyst to provide functional production support for enterprise Contract Management Software (CMS/CLM) platforms. This role focuses on incident resolution, configuration support, and close collaboration with business users and technical teams to ensure system stability and efficient contract operations.

Key Responsibilities

  • Provide Level 2 production support for Contract Management Software platforms, including incident, problem, and service request management.
  • Analyze and resolve issues related to:
  • Contract templates, clause libraries, and fallback logic
  • Workflows, approvals, and business rule configurations
  • Metadata, attributes, and contract type setups
  • Perform root cause analysis for recurring functional and configuration-related issues.
  • Support minor enhancements and functional configuration changes (non-code).
  • Troubleshoot integration-related issues and coordinate with Level 3 technical teams when required.
  • Manage user access, role assignments, and permission-related issues.
  • Execute approved data corrections, metadata updates, and configuration fixes.
  • Support UAT and regression testing for fixes and minor platform updates.
  • Maintain support documentation, knowledge articles, and operational runbooks.
  • Collaborate closely with L1 support teams, business stakeholders, and L3 technical teams to ensure timely issue resolution.

Required Skills & Experience

  • 3+ years of experience providing production support for Contract Management Software (CLM/CMS) platforms (e.g., Icertis, Coupa CLM, DocuSign CLM, SAP CLM, or similar).
  • Strong hands-on experience with functional configurations, including:
  • Contract templates and clause libraries
  • Workflows, rules, and approvals
  • English (B2- Fluent)
  • Metadata, attributes, and contract types
  • Solid understanding of contract lifecycle management processes .
  • Experience working with ITSM tools (e.g., ServiceNow).
  • Strong analytical, communication, and stakeholder management skills.

Nice to Have

  • Experience supporting enterprise SaaS applications in complex or regulated environments.
  • Exposure to system integrations with ERP, CRM, or document management platforms.
  • Familiarity with ITIL-based support models or Agile delivery environments.

UST is waiting for you!

title: Executivo Comercial Hunter - Grandes Contas - Mercado Pago | Natal, RN.

No Mercado Livre estamos democratizando o comércio e os serviços financeiros para transformar a vida das pessoas na América Latina. Faça parte deste propósito!

  • Prospectar ativamente novos clientes com o perfil de Grandes Contas.

  • Sustentar relacionamentos estratégicos com clientes e parceiros de negócio e monitorar tendências de mercado, comportamento da concorrência e oportunidades de crescimento para a sua região de atuação.
  • Trabalhar em sinergia com equipes de produtos e operações para garantir a melhor entrega ao cliente.

title: Senior Applied Scientist (AI/ML - Inbound Team)
description:
Senior Applied Scientist – AI/ML Customer Science (Remote – Brazil)

Location: 100% Remote (Brazil)

Employment Type: PJ – Long term

About the Role

We are looking for a Senior Applied Scientist to design, develop, and deploy advanced machine learning, causal inference, and optimization systems that drive Marketing and Sales decision-making.

In this role, you will transform complex customer behavior and business growth challenges into measurable objectives and scalable ML solutions across acquisition, conversion, retention, and revenue optimization.

You will work at the intersection of machine learning, experimentation, causal inference, and business strategy in a fast-paced, collaborative, and entrepreneurial environment.

What You’ll Work On

You will build models and platforms that create impact across areas such as:

  • Sales prioritization and expected value modeling
  • Marketing targeting and uplift modeling
  • Multi-touch attribution and incrementality measurement
  • Customer lifecycle modeling (conversion, retention, churn, LTV)
  • Outreach optimization and personalization systems

Responsibilities

  • Research, design, and develop machine learning, statistical, and causal models for Marketing and Sales use cases including:
  • Propensity and expected value modeling
  • Uplift and treatment effect estimation
  • Attribution and marketing measurement
  • Forecasting, optimization, and prioritization systems
  • Translate business growth problems into clear objectives, loss functions, and evaluation frameworks
  • Design feature representations capturing customer behavior, engagement, and lifecycle dynamics
  • Design and analyze experiments (A/B tests, geo tests, incrementality tests, diff-in-diff, causal impact)
  • Build and maintain robust evaluation frameworks aligned with business outcomes (ROI, CAC, conversion, retention, LTV)
  • Own the end-to-end ML lifecycle: data ingestion, feature engineering, training, deployment, monitoring
  • Develop scalable ML services integrated into business workflows (CRM, marketing platforms, internal tools)
  • Partner closely with Product, Engineering, Marketing, Sales, and Data teams
  • Influence technical direction and roadmap prioritization based on business impact
  • Clearly communicate insights and model behavior to technical and non-technical stakeholders
  • Mentor junior scientists and engineers and help establish best practices
  • Contribute to long-term data science strategy, platforms, and innovation

Minimum Qualifications

  • 5+ years of industry experience in applied Machine Learning
  • Master’s degree or PhD in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Statistics, Operations Research, or related field
  • 3+ years of experience building, deploying, and managing ML models in production at scale
  • Strong knowledge of ML best practices (feature engineering, experimentation, pipelines, model evaluation)
  • Experience with modern ML techniques including gradient boosting, deep learning, transformers, and optimization
  • Experience in Computer Vision (Causal Inference experience is a strong plus)
  • Proficiency in Python and SQL
  • Hands-on experience with ML frameworks: PyTorch, TensorFlow, Keras, Scikit-learn
  • Strong data engineering skills with large-scale datasets
  • Experience with big data tools such as Apache Beam, Kafka, Spark
  • Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, or Azure)

Preferred Qualifications

  • PhD in CS, ML, AI, Statistics, Operations Research, or related field
  • Experience applying ML in retail or commercial business contexts
  • Familiarity with MLOps tools and production pipelines
  • Strong leadership and mentoring experience
  • Impact-driven mindset with a focus on delivering high-quality, scalable solutions

About the Role

We are looking for a Senior Applied Scientist to design, develop, and deploy advanced machine learning, causal inference, and optimization systems that drive Marketing and Sales decision-making.

In this role, you will transform complex customer behavior and business growth challenges into measurable objectives and scalable ML solutions across acquisition, conversion, retention, and revenue optimization.

You will work at the intersection of machine learning, experimentation, causal inference, and business strategy in a fast-paced, collaborative, and entrepreneurial environment.

  • Uplift and treatment effect estimation
  • Attribution and marketing measurement

title: Digital Ad Designer
description:
About Lilo Social

Lilo Social is a full-funnel eCommerce growth agency specializing in acquisition and retention for direct-to-consumer brands. With a team of over 75 professionals, we deliver best-in-class paid media, email marketing, and creative services to help brands scale profitably. We work across the entire customer lifecycle—from content creation and paid advertising to conversion rate optimization and retention marketing.

Our partnership-first approach has earned us a 90% client retention rate and recognition as an Inc. 5000 honoree for three consecutive years (2023, 2024, 2025). We are proud to be a Klaviyo Master Elite Agency, a distinction held by only 0.2% of Klaviyo's 6,500+ partners. To date, we have driven billions of dollars in attributed revenue for our partners.

The Role

As a Digital Ad Designer at Lilo Social, you will create scroll-stopping static graphics for Meta advertising campaigns while designing high-converting landing pages that drive measurable results for DTC brands. You will collaborate closely with creative strategists and media buyers to translate performance insights into compelling visual creative that captures attention and converts browsers into buyers.

What Success Looks Like

  • Consistent improvement in creative performance metrics (CTR, conversion rate, thumb-stop rate) across your client portfolio
  • Fast iteration speed that enables creative variations per week with maintained quality standards
  • High client satisfaction through on-brand designs that align with strategic creative direction
  • Strong cross-functional collaboration that accelerates testing velocity and produces scalable winning concepts

Responsibilities

  • Design high-performing static graphics for Meta ad campaigns across feed, stories, and reels formats
  • Create conversion-focused landing pages that align with ad messaging and drive customer action
  • Execute on creative briefs provided by strategists, translating concepts into visually compelling designs
  • Iterate quickly based on performance data, A/B test results, and stakeholder feedback
  • Maintain brand consistency and visual standards across multiple client accounts simultaneously
  • Design mobile-first experiences optimized for Meta's platform specifications and best practices
  • Organize and manage design files, asset libraries, and version control using established naming conventions
  • Collaborate with media buyers to understand campaign objectives and creative testing priorities
  • Stay current on Meta platform trends, ad formats, and direct response design principles
  • Produce landing page designs that integrate seamlessly with existing brand systems and conversion frameworks
  • Participate in creative reviews and provide design rationale grounded in performance marketing principles
  • Adapt existing creative concepts into new formats, sizes, and placements efficiently

Requirements

  • 3-4 years of design experience in performance marketing, advertising, or DTC ecommerce
  • Expert proficiency in Figma for design collaboration and file organization
  • Strong command of Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop and Illustrator)
  • Portfolio demonstrating direct response creative and performance-focused design work
  • Proven experience designing ads specifically for Meta (Facebook and Instagram)
  • Understanding of mobile-first design principles and responsive layout techniques
  • Demonstrated ability to iterate quickly while maintaining high quality standards
  • Experience designing landing pages with conversion rate optimization in mind
  • Organized approach to file management with attention to naming conventions and version control
  • Comfort working with performance feedback and data-driven design decisions
  • Strong communication skills and ability to articulate design decisions
  • Self-starter mentality with ability to manage multiple client accounts and deadlines

Nice to Have

  • Motion graphics or animation skills with proficiency in After Effects or similar tools
  • Experience with landing page builders (Unbounce, Instapage, Replo, Shogun)
  • HTML/CSS knowledge for basic landing page customization
  • Understanding of Meta Ads Manager and campaign performance metrics
  • Experience working in an agency environment with multiple simultaneous client accounts
  • Familiarity with Shopify and ecommerce product page design
  • Knowledge of direct response copywriting principles and how they inform design hierarchy
  • Experience designing for additional platforms (TikTok, Google Display, YouTube)

Compensation and Benefits

  • Fully Remote : Work from anywhere with flexible hours and a distributed team culture
  • Generous Time Off : Competitive PTO policy and paid holidays to maintain work-life balance
  • Compensation: Competitive salary commensurate with experience.

title: Senior Applied Scientist - Computer Vision & Machine Learning
description:
Senior Applied Scientist – Computer Vision & Machine Learning

Location: Brazil (remote)

Contract: PJ (long-term)

We’re looking for a Senior Applied Scientist to join our Inbound team and build highly scalable machine learning solutions that power item attribute detection (e.g., color, material, style) and merchandise authenticity verification.

If you’re passionate about solving real-world business problems using state-of-the-art Computer Vision and ML techniques — and enjoy taking ownership from research to production — we’d love to connect.

What You’ll Do

  • Develop and deploy Computer Vision and Machine Learning solutions to solve high-impact business challenges
  • Design, build, and maintain clean, efficient, and scalable production-grade code
  • Analyze large-scale datasets to extract insights and drive data-informed decisions
  • Apply state-of-the-art ML methodologies (CNNs, Transformers, GANs, etc.) to build robust models
  • Lead the technical direction of key components and systems
  • Collaborate closely with Product, Engineering, and Tech Leads to deliver deployable solutions
  • Mentor team members and help grow domain expertise
  • Contribute to technical leadership through patents and publications

Minimum Qualifications

  • 5+ years of industry experience in Computer Vision and Applied Machine Learning
  • Master’s or PhD in CS, ML, Statistics, or related field (or 8+ years of industry experience)
  • 3+ years building, deploying, and managing ML/DL models in production at scale
  • Deep understanding of ML/CV techniques: CNNs, Transformers, GANs, optimizers, regularization
  • Strong experience with experiment design, A/B testing, training/serving pipelines, and feature engineering
  • Proficiency in Python and scientific libraries (NumPy, Pandas)
  • Hands-on experience with ML frameworks (PyTorch, TensorFlow, Keras, Scikit-learn)
  • Strong data engineering skills with large-scale datasets
  • Experience with experiment automation tools (Ray Tune, Weights & Biases, Kubeflow)
  • Cloud experience (AWS, GCP, or Azure)

Preferred Qualifications

  • PhD in CS, ML, AI, Statistics, OR, or related field
  • Experience applying ML to real-world retail problems
  • Familiarity with MLOps pipelines and tools
  • Strong ownership mindset with a focus on measurable business impact

title: College-Level Chemistry Tutor
description:
We are looking for tutors to solve college-level Chemistry questions in English. These questions are submitted by students, who expect a response in less than 24 hours.

Tutors in this project work in freelance mode and can decide the number of hours they wish to work.

Do you prefer to work in the morning, in the evening, for a few hours or many hours? The choice is yours. You can log in at any time to help students. In addition, you can work from anywhere, as long as you have a computer with a reliable Internet connection.

We need tutors who can start immediately!

Characteristics

Payment in dollars.

Type of contract: freelance/self-employed.

Schedule: Flexible, free choice

Start: Immediate

Duration: Indefinite

Requirements

  • Ability to solve university-level questions in at least one of the following subjects:
  • General Chemistry
  • Organic Chemistry
  • Student or graduate of a university course whose curriculum includes at least one of the subjects listed in the previous point.
  • Computer with an Internet connection.
  • No criminal record.

About LatinHire

Founded in 2003, LatinHire is a company specialising in managing teams of experts for distance learning institutions. Its clients include some of the world's most prestigious education startups.

title: PESSOA COORDENADORA DE CIÊNCIA DE DADOS - REMOTO
description:
Descrição da vaga

A SOMOS Educação é um dos principais grupos de educação básica do Brasil, oferecendo uma ampla variedade de soluções educacionais. Nossos serviços incluem sistemas de ensino, editoras, soluções de ensino complementares e uma plataforma tecnológica de aprendizado digital e e-commerce. Com isso, nos apresentamos como parceiros integrais das escolas.

Entre as marcas que compõem o nosso grupo estão Anglo, PH, Plurall, Líder em Mim e outras. Nossa missão é transformar o ecossistema das escolas privadas, combinando educação e gestão de alta qualidade com base na neurociência e na tecnologia em larga escala. Além disso, buscamos liderar as escolas no processo de transformação digital, visando ser o principal agente de reinvenção da educação para o aluno e a escola do século XXI.

Para cumprir essa missão e entregar o melhor para as nossas escolas, baseamos nosso trabalho em valores fundamentais. Valorizamos a autonomia e o apoio, o bem-estar, a excelência, a liderança e a inovação em nossa rotina de trabalho. Somos o único grupo educacional classificado como uma das Melhores Empresas para se trabalhar, Great Place to Work – GPTW.

Responsabilidades e atribuições:

- Coordenar a equipe de tecnologia, garantindo a qualidade e integridade das informações;

- Realizar análise de dados, utilizando técnicas de Business Intelligence e Data Mining;

- Gerenciar o banco de dados e implementar soluções de Big Data;

- Liderar projetos de análise de dados e extração de insights;

- Resolver problemas relacionados à manipulação e interpretação de dados;

- Promover a comunicação eficaz entre a equipe e demais áreas da empresa.

Requisitos e qualificações:

- Graduação em Ciência da Computação

- Pós-graduação em Análise de Dados

- Certificação em Big Data

- Experiência comprovada em análise de dados e gestão de equipes

- Conhecimento em estatística e técnicas de Machine Learning

- Habilidade de liderança, trabalho em equipe e adaptabilidade

- Excelentes habilidades de comunicação e resolução de problemas

O que você pode esperar da gente?

  • Participação nos lucros: resultados com comemoração fazem parte do jeito Cogna.
  • Vale-refeição ou alimentação: num cartão de benefícios flexível.
  • Assistência médica: um abrangente plano de saúde, com inclusão de dependentes e coparticipação.
  • Assistência odontológica: está disponível para manter seu sorriso.

Mas espera, ainda tem mais!

  • Bolsas de estudo de graduação e pós graduação: nossas unidades de ensino para que você e seus dependentes (cônjuge e filhos).
  • Day off no aniversário: você poderá escolher um dia para relaxar e celebrar.
  • Convênio farmácia Univers: descontos numa variedade de medicamentos.
  • Universidade corporativa: diversas trilhas e cursos gratuitos na nossa universidade corporativa para você seguir evoluindo com a gente.
  • Descontos em livros: para você adquirir os melhores títulos em nossas editoras.
  • Wellhub (Gympass): para que você possa se movimentar no seu dia a dia.
  • Conexa: Atendimento psicológico gratuito para cuidar da sua saúde mental.
  • Programa Ninho: Um programa dedicado às nossas famílias que estão aguardando um novo bebê.
  • Valoriza - Programa de Recrutamento Interno: Para impulsionar sua carreira por meio de oportunidades internas.

Aqui, acreditamos no respeito, na diversidade e na busca da inclusão em todas suas frentes. Todos os candidatos qualificados serão considerados independentemente de raça, gênero, identidade, expressão de gênero, orientação sexual, nacionalidade, genética, deficiência ou de qualquer outra base.

Nosso propósito é avançar cada vez mais, gerando empregabilidade para talentos diversos. Venha enriquecer nosso time!

title: Founding Engineer
description:
About Able

Able is the AI front office for Wholesale Plumbing, HVAC, and Electrical Suppliers. We're automating the soul-crushing manual work that buries inside sales teams - starting with fixture quoting.

The Wholesale Supply market is a $350B+ market running on spreadsheets and tribal knowledge. We're building the infrastructure to change that.

About the Role

Founding Engineer, with a focus on shipping Agents. You'll spec features, debug weird edge cases, scale infrastructure and help us figure out what to build next based on what customers actually need.

We're not looking for someone who needs a roadmap handed to them. We're looking for somebody who wants to help build the roadmap. If you see a problem, you fix it. If you don't know something, you learn it.

What we're looking for

  • 3 to 5 years of Software Engineering experience
  • Backend depth — you're comfortable owning a Python/FastAPI service end-to-end, from async request handling to data modeling to production debugging
  • Agent & LLM Fluent - you understand how agentic systems work and the failure modes that arise
  • Cloud comfortable - GCP, Firestore, Pub/Sub, Vercel, & Docker. You don't need to be an infra specialist but you shouldn't be scared of it
  • Document intelligence - comfortable working with document parsing & extraction pipelines (OCR, layout analysis, structured extraction, etc)

You're Likely a Fit If

  • You've designed, built, and shipped something with LLMs or Agents with real users
  • You're comfortable making decisions and backing up your logic
  • You default to shipping over planning. Iteration > Perfection
  • You've worked in an early-stage company before and are ready for the chaos
  • You're a tinkerer - also playing around with new technologies or projects

What You'll Do

  • Work with the Founding team to collect user feedback, design feature specs, implement updates, and deploy to production
  • Work across the stack: Python/FastAPI, Next.js/Typescript, Firebase, Docker, GCP, etc
  • Debug production issues and make them obsolete
  • Build and improve agent workflows using home grown frameworks
  • Help shape the product roadmap
  • Stay up to date on modern agent architectures/improvements and implement where
  • necessary

Want some Bonus Points?

We've set up an MCP server at ` - candidates who know what to do with it will find something useful

title: Executive Search Consultant
description:
About Gold & Aron:

Gold & Aron Conseil is a boutique executive search firm with a 20+ year track record of placing top-tier talent in the Technology and Financial Services industries across the Americas and Europe.

About the Role

We are hiring an Executive Search Senior Associate to support Gold & Aron CEO and COO across high-impact searches in Technology and Financial Services in a premium boutique environment. The role blends deep research, pipeline development, and end-to-end recruiting for select mid-level roles. You’ll help build the engine that enables leadership to focus on client strategy and firm growth.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

Candidate Research & Sourcing for senior level searches (60%)

  • Build and manage strong candidate pipelines across multiple concurrent searches.
  • Active search: Conduct structured research, market mapping using several tech tools including Linkedin, AI tools and own data base.
  • Passive search: Source, screen applicants
  • Lead candidate scoring, initial candidate assessment

End to end Recruiting for selected mid level searches (30%)

  • Build and manage candidate pipeline
  • Conduct first-round screens to assess fit and motivation.
  • Prepare concise candidate summaries and search updates.
  • Support client communications and progress check-ins.
  • Coordinate interviews and every other step of the hiring process.

Business Development Support (10%)

  • Research companies, markets, and potential clients
  • Build prospect lists and market intelligence for the CEO and COO.
  • Bring new ideas, new BD initiatives for the company

IDEAL CANDIDATE PROFILE

  • 3–7+ years in research, consulting, finance, tech, recruiting, or similar fields.

title: England Packaging Salesperson, Remote
description:
We are a leading cosmetic packaging company. Our product offerings support beauty, personal care, and cosmetic brands with high-quality, compliant, and market-ready packaging.

Role Description

We are seeking an experienced English Cosmetic Packaging Salesperson to join our sales team. This is a full-time remote position reporting to our Sales Manager. The ideal candidate will have proven experience selling cosmetic and personal care packaging products into English markets, with a strong understanding of English business practices, regulations, and cultural nuances.

Compensation: $65,000 to $135,000 per year, depending on experience.

Responsibilities

The successful candidate will be responsible for:

- Developing and maintaining relationships with English cosmetic and personal care brands

- Identifying and pursuing new sales opportunities within England's cosmetic packaging market

- Presenting cosmetic packaging solutions tailored to brand, regulatory, and consumer requirements

- Managing sales pipelines, forecasting, and reporting

- Collaborating with product development, compliance, and logistics teams to ensure customer satisfaction

- Meeting and exceeding sales targets

- Staying informed on market trends, regulations, and competitor activity in English cosmetic packaging markets

Qualifications

- Proven track record of successful B2B sales in cosmetic packaging or closely related packaging industries

- Extensive experience working with English cosmetic, beauty, or personal care markets and customers

- Strong knowledge of English cosmetic packaging regulations, standards, and labeling requirements

- Fluent in English

- Excellent communication, negotiation, and relationship-building skills

- Ability to travel to England as needed (20-30% of the time)

- Bachelor's degree in Business, Sales, or a related field

- Proficiency with CRM systems and sales tools

- Salesforce experience is a plus

title: Desenvolvedor Fullstack .Net + React
description:
Código da Vaga: 58095

Sobre a BRQ Digital

Há 33 anos no mercado, a BRQ Digital Solutions se consolidou como uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país. Com uma plataforma de serviços end to end, oferecemos as mais eficientes e inovadoras soluções, tecnologias e metodologias, promovendo uma jornada de transformação para grandes marcas, de diferentes segmentos, no Brasil e no exterior.

Temos 3 mil funcionários e a empresa é destaque como um dos melhores lugares para trabalhar pelo GPTW e Glassdoor.

BRQ WAY

No nosso BRQ WAY temos a missão de conectar, transformar e empoderar cada um dos nossos profissionais, que por aqui são chamados de feras, para que todos tenham a chance de usar sua paixão para transformar o mundo com tecnologia!

É isso que queremos, com nosso Programa de Diversidade e Inclusão trabalhamos com dois objetivos: equidade e inclusão, buscamos aumentar a participação dos grupos minoritários, quebrar os vieses inconscientes e expandir a conscientização sobre temas tão importantes para que todos sejam livres para serem quem são.

Vamos transformar juntos! Vem ser fera com a gente!

- O que procuramos?

Buscamos um #fera com espírito empreendedor e que sabe que é o verdadeiro protagonista do seu sucesso! Queremos em nosso time pessoas motivadas por desafios, constante evolução e, claro, que são apaixonadas por tecnologia e transformação!

Responsabilidades:

Experiência em .NET e React

Projetar, implementar e manter soluções baseadas em arquitetura de microsserviços;

Gerenciar e otimizar infraestrutura em AWS (EC2, ECS, Lambda, S3, etc.);

Desenvolver integrações e fluxos assíncronos utilizando RabbitMQ ou Kafka e outras soluções de mensageria;

Trabalhar com bancos de dados relacionais (SQL Server, MySQL) e não relacionais (MongoDB); Garantir boas práticas de segurança,

Conhecimento em containers (Docker, Kubernetes);

Vivência com sistemas de alta disponibilidade e escalabilidade.

Contratação CLT + Hibrido no Rio de janeiro 3 dias.

- O que temos pra te oferecer?

Mais do que um plano de carreira!

A BRQ acredita que cada fera deve ser protagonista do seu crescimento, tendo autonomia para criar seu próprio plano de desenvolvimento profissional. Nosso plano de carreira é dividido em 4 pilares:

Carreira técnica: Você pode seguir a trilha de crescimento técnico, se o seu objetivo for se desenvolver cada vez mais em diferentes tecnologias. Oferecemos diversos treinamentos!

Carreira de Liderança: Você pode seguir a trilha e se tornar um líder, desenvolver pessoas, auxiliar na evolução profissional e pessoal e estimular o crescimento para o surgimento de novos talentos.

Experiência internacional: Estamos crescendo cada vez mais fora do Brasil e você tem possibilidade de atuar em projetos para outros países, ou diretamente nos países onde a BRQ tem sede.

Empreendedorismo: De funcionário para sócio! Temos o Innovation Hub, a Corporate Venture que investe em ideias de profissionais que tenham sinergia com nosso negócio.

- E os benefícios?

Plano de Saúde; Plano Odontológico; Seguro de Vida; Vale Refeição; Vale Alimentação; Horário Flexível; Gympass, Telemedicina, Telenutrição, Canal de suporte emocional 24h e muito mais!

- Como é trabalhar na BRQ?

Temos um clima descontraído, diversos programas e eventos internos. Adoramos comemorar! E fazemos isso muito bem! Veja aqui no Youtube: youtube.com/brqdigitalsolutions

Curtiu? Então inscreva-se e venha para o melhor da Transformação Digital com a gente!

title: English Teacher
description:
Are you a Portuguese speaker who graduated as an English Teacher? We are looking for you!

Teach fun English classes online via Zoom from the comfort of your own home! You can set your own hours and teach on the go as long as you have a solid color backdrop, a laptop, good WiFi, a webcam, and a microphone.

If you love teaching, but dread prepping for lessons and grading, this is the perfect job for you. We provide our teachers with all the lesson materials so all you have to do is show up for class and do what you do best, which is teach!

Whether you’re looking for a second stream of income or a full-time job, we’ve got you covered. You can work as little as 16 hours a month up to as much as 30 hours a week.

What is a typical day for an Online English Teacher at LatinHire?

You will be scheduled shifts two weeks in advance according to the availability you provide us and we also offer the flexibility of dropping shifts and picking up extra shifts.

If you are busier one week, you can drop some of your shifts and have other teachers help you out or if you want to earn more $$ another week, you can pick up extra shifts and help other teachers out.

When you are on shift, you log on to our platform and teach the lessons provided as well as write short feedback for the students after class. Simple as that!

In short, here are some reasons why you will love working as an Online English Teacher with LatinHire:

title: Contract Clinical Research Associate
description:
Clinical Research Associate (Oncology) – São Paulo (0.4 FTE, Rescue Study)

We are seeking an experienced Clinical Research Associate (CRA) to support a Phase 2 oncology rescue study in solid tumors. The role is part‑time (0.4 FTE) and based in São Paulo, with on‑site visits to the study site every 6–8 weeks.

Key Details

  • Therapeutic area: Oncology – solid tumor
  • Phase: 2
  • 1 year contract
  • Start date: ASAP

Responsibilities

  • Perform regular on‑site monitoring visits approximately every 6–8 weeks
  • Ensure protocol compliance, data quality, and patient safety in a rescue study setting
  • Complete source data verification and support data clean‑up and query resolution
  • Review and maintain essential documents and site files
  • Collaborate closely with site staff and the project team to address study issues and implement corrective actions as needed

Requirements

  • 4–5 years of experience as a CRA
  • Proven experience monitoring oncology clinical trials, ideally in solid tumors
  • Prior experience with Phase 2 studies preferred
  • Strong knowledge of ICH‑GCP and clinical research regulations
  • Based in São Paulo (or able to reliably travel to sites in São Paulo)
  • Able to start on short notice (ASAP)

If you meet the above criteria and are interested in supporting this Phase 2 oncology rescue study, please submit your CV and availability.

title: Structural Engineer | Fully Remote | English Speaking
description:
Brazilstrat is hiring: Structural Engineer | Fully Remote | English Speaking

Brazilstrat connects top-tier Brazilian remote talent with organizations abroad. We are currently selecting a Structural Engineer to join a US-based partner company.

In this role, you will work remotely performing structural analysis and design for projects including awnings and similar outdoor structures. This is an ideal position for an experienced engineer looking for flexible, project-based work with the potential to grow into a full-time role.

Key Responsibilities:

* Structural Analysis: perform detailed structural calculations and analysis for outdoor structures such as awnings.

* Design & Documentation: prepare structural drawings, specifications, and technical reports that meet international standards and client requirements.

* Software Modeling: use structural analysis software (SAP2000 or equivalent) to model loads, stresses, and structural behavior.

* Technical Collaboration: coordinate with architects, fabricators, and project managers to ensure structural integrity and constructability of designs.

* Quality Assurance: review designs for compliance with applicable building codes and engineering best practices.

Requirements:

* 3-5 years of experience in structural engineering, preferably with exposure to steel, aluminum, or lightweight structures.

* Advanced/Fluent English (spoken and written) is mandatory.

* Proficiency with structural analysis software such as SAP2000.

* Strong understanding of structural mechanics, load calculations, and material properties.

* Tech-savvy: comfortable with CAD tools, Excel for calculations, and modern productivity software. Experience using AI tools to increase efficiency is a plus.

* Detail-oriented with strong documentation and communication skills.

* Self-motivated and able to manage project timelines independently in a remote setting.

What We Offer:

* 100% remote, home-office flexibility.

* Flexible hours/project-based engagement to start, with potential to develop into a full-time position.

* Exposure to international projects and clients.

* Growth opportunities within a scaling global network.

How to Apply: Please complete our initial screening form here:

Only selected candidates will be contacted for the next steps.

title: Account Executive
description:
About UserGuiding

UserGuiding is a leader in the digital adoption field and has earned a 'Best Software' placement on G2 for two consecutive years. We work with globally recognized companies such as TOTVS, WEG, Caju, Wolters Kluwer, DigitalOcean, and Philip Morris International.

Role Objective

UserGuiding is looking for a results-driven, trilingual Account Executive to spearhead our growth across the Americas. Your primary mission is to lead our expansion in the Brazilian market, while also capturing opportunities in North America and Spanish-speaking LATAM.

You will own the entire revenue pipeline for your region, serving as the primary point of contact for prospects from their first discovery call to their final signature.

Main Responsibilities

1. Full-Cycle Sales & Closing

  • Execute Inbound/Outbound: Manage inbound leads and signups from Brazil, the US, and LATAM. Perform high-impact discovery calls and tailored product demos.
  • Negotiation & Closing: Lead contract negotiations and overcome objections to convert signups into long-term partners.
  • Cross-Regional Support: While focused on Brazil (Portuguese), you will leverage your time to handle inbound calls and outreach for the US (English) and other LATAM countries (Spanish).

2. Pipeline Generation & Outreach

  • Proactive Prospecting: Engage with high-intent signups and conduct outbound outreach to key decision-makers (Product People and UX Designers).
  • Event Advocacy: Attend and represent UserGuiding at major industry events and meetups in Brazil to build a self-sustaining pipeline.
  • Thought Leadership: Regularly share insights, product updates, and industry trends to build a personal brand that attracts inbound interest on LinkedIn.

3. Strategy & CRM Excellence

  • Market Insights: Feed local market trends and customer needs back to our Product and Marketing teams to help refine our messaging in the region.
  • Hubspot Management: Maintain 100% CRM accuracy, ensuring all deals are properly forecasted and followed up on.

Candidate Profile & Experience

  • Experience: 2–4 years of experience in a sales-centric role, with at least 1 year specifically as an Account Executive within a B2B SaaS startup.

Linguistic Versatility:

  • Portuguese: Native-level (Primary market focus).
  • English: Professional fluency (Internal coordination & North American deals).
  • Spanish: High proficiency (Managing Spanish-speaking LATAM territories).
  • Skills: Strong consultative selling skills, public speaking confidence, and the ability to navigate a \"no-code\" technical environment. We don’t want someone to show our playground in the first minute. Our sales calls should be in the interview format.

Tech Stack

  • Sales: Hubspot CRM, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Clay, Apollo.io
  • Comm: Google Meet, Slack.

Compensation & Benefits

  • Base Salary: Competitive fixed monthly salary.
  • Variable Bonus: Uncapped quarterly bonuses based on New Business Revenue (NBR) and pipeline targets.
  • Impact: A high-autonomy role where you directly influence UserGuiding's global expansion strategy.

title: Professor de alemão
description:
Vaga para Professor de Alemão (REMOTO)

Descrição da Vaga:

Estamos em busca de um professor de alemão qualificado e dedicado para se juntar à nossa equipe de ensino online no Instituto Stephanie Lich. Se você é um profissional experiente em ensino online, organizado, atento às demandas específicas de cada aluno, e busca uma oportunidade em uma instituição que valoriza o desenvolvimento contínuo e oferece suporte constante ao professor, essa vaga é para você!

Requisitos:

  • Disponibilidade: Flexibilidade de horário, para atender à crescente demanda de alunos que chegam de forma orgânica por meio das nossas redes e marketing e parcerias.
  • Experiência e Flexibilidade : Experiência comprovada no ensino remoto de alemão e experiência e flexibilidade para utilizar diversoso materiais didáticos em sala de aula.
  • Habilidades Tecnológicas : Domínio de plataformas de ensino online, como salas de aula virtuais com lousa digital e aplicativos complementares. O pleno domínio do Google Meet é imprescindível.
  • Comunicação: Ter uma boa comunicação, tanto com os alunos quanto com a parte administrativa do Instituto.

Competências

  • Capacidade de conduzir aulas interativas e envolventes, usando diversas ferramentas tecnológicas para otimizar o aprendizado.
  • É fundamental atenção às demandas e necessidades dos alunos em prol de garantir um ensino personalizado e eficaz.

Oferecemos:

Remuneração Competitiva: Uma hora-aula de R$ 40,00 atrativa e alinhada com o mercado, comparável às demais escolas de idiomas.

Suporte ao Professor: Fornecemos todo o suporte necessário, incluindo um convênio Google para utilizações de ferramentes pagas pelo Instituto, materiais didáticos atualizados para facilitar o processo de ensino e um material didático próprio do Instituto.

Ambiente de Trabalho : Um ambiente colaborativo e de apoio, onde valorizamos o desenvolvimento contínuo dos professores e incentivamos o aprimoramento constante.

Estamos ansiosos para conhecer você e, juntos, proporcionar uma experiência de aprendizado única para nossos alunos!

title: Customer Service Representative (Portuguese)
description:
About BingX

  • A leading crypto exchange since 2018
  • With 20 million registered users worldwide
  • Official crypto exchange partner of Chelsea FC
  • User-First, reliable, innovative, and diversified
  • List over 1,000 spot trading pairs
  • Offer over 300 futures trading pairs
  • Integrate with over 80 public chain ecosystems
  • Rank top on CoinMarketCap and CoinGecko
  • TradingView's Best Crypto Exchange for 2021, 2022 & 2023
  • A gateway for the next billion crypto users

Founded in 2018, BingX is a leading cryptocurrency exchange, serving over 20 million users worldwide. BingX offers diversified products and services, including spot, derivatives, copy trading, and asset management – all designed for the evolving needs of users, from beginners to professionals.

BingX is committed to providing a trustworthy platform that empowers users with innovative tools and features to elevate their trading proficiency.

Our current vacancy | Full-time | Long-term | REMOTE

Responsibilities

  • Handle customer inquiries via live chat, email, and other channels regarding accounts, trading, payments, etc.
  • Assist customers with KYC verification, account security setup, and dispute resolution.
  • Accurately document and escalate customer issues, collaborating with technical teams for complex cases.
  • Stay updated on futures trading rules and promptly communicate platform announcements/risk alerts (training provided).
  • Adapt to shift schedules (if required) to ensure coverage during target market hours.
  • Willing to work weekends and irregular hours which will include night shifts.

Requirements

  • Have an online customer support experience, and proficiency in tools like Zendesk/LiveChat.
  • Fast learner, able to master derivatives trading terminology quickly.
  • Patient, resilient, and skilled in de-escalating high-tension situations.
  • Familiarity with Brazilian/Portuguese user communication styles; finance or customer service experience preferred.
  • Proficiency in Portuguese and English is essential.
